78823.completion: Well now. This is certainly interesting...
78823.objectives: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78823.text: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
78823.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

7883.completion: Oh dear, these are quite large!! I can't imagine finding a gnome that would fit snuggly into them, but not to worry - if the gnome we find is not big enough, I can make adjustments to his costume.$B$BMany thanks, $N. Here are the tickets I promised you.
7883.title: The World's Largest Gnome!

78830.completion: Now there's a feather for your cap! Nicely done, $N.$B$BYou can rest here for a while, if you like. I'm sure your trek through the desert was arduous.
78830.objectives: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78830.progress: How goes the hunt? Surely the bird hasn't got you beat!
78830.text:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.
78830.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

7884.completion: Great, you made them! These will do nicely... I just hope I won't be the one to clean the crocolisk cage when the time comes. Those beasts can be rather beastly, don't you think?$B$BHere are your tickets, $N. Enjoy them, and enjoy your stay at the Darkmoon Faire!
7884.title: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc

7893.title: Rituals of Strength

7894.completion: Aha! The modulators! Superb!$B$BI can't tell you exactly what we're building, but these will be invaluable for its construction. I am in your debt, $N, but please, take this Darkmoon Faire ticket as a token of my appreciation.
7894.title: Copper Modulator

7895.completion: You brought the gizmos! Wonderful! Even now I can hear their buzzing, whirring chorus in my mind! Oh, when this booth is ready it will be the wonder of the world, mark me!$B$BHere are you tickets, $N. And please enjoy your stay at the Faire!
7895.title: Whirring Bronze Gizmo

7896.completion: You brought the fireworks. Wonderful work, $N! I can't wait to light these and tell the world that my booth is ready to go! I must still wait, quite a long time I'm afraid, but... I'll be ready when I'm ready, yes?$B$BHere are the tickets, $N. Enjoy yourself!
7896.title: Green Fireworks

7897.completion: Thank you! Now I can get to fixing things.$B$BIt's going to take a lot of repair kits and a lot of late nights to get everything in working order. Sometimes I think it'd be better to get back to my roots and restart my career as a headhunter, but... the Faire has been good to me.$B$BTake these tickets, $N, and have fun!
7897.title: Mechanical Repair Kits

7898.completion: Ah, thank you, $N! Yebb will enjoy these widgets. I don't know what he has planned for them, but Yebb's a clever little gnome. He's clever, and maybe a little devious....$B$BIf only he liked the taste of humanoid flesh... he'd make a great troll!$B$BHere, $N. A deal's a deal, and these tickets are yours.
7898.title: Thorium Widget

7899.completion: Great, you got them! We can use these to make toys and baubles, and those will attract more people to the Faire!$B$BHere's your ticket, $N. You earned it!
7899.title: Small Furry Paws

7900.completion: Nice pelts, $N! I'll get someone to sew these into a bunch of plush toys. With a little stuffing and some paint, I think they'll be the envy of children across Azeroth!$B$BTickets? Ah yes, your payment! Here they are!
7900.title: Torn Bear Pelts

79007.completion: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
79007.objectives: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.title: ... and that note you found

7901.title: Soft Bushy Tails

7902.completion: Ah, the plumes! They are amazing, don't you think! It would be easy to spark one's imaginations with such beauties!$B$BYou do such charitable work, $N. The smiles on our visitors' faces when they see the show is a grand payment indeed, but please take these tickets as well.
7902.title: Vibrant Plumes

79192.completion: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.
79192.objectives: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.
79192.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.title: Stepping Stones

79229.completion: Ah, so you found another one...
79229.objectives: Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
79229.text:
The campsite before you is a grisly scene. Judging by the remains, the victims were two humans and a dwarf. Markings on the bones indicate a savage attack, but the looted supplies tell you this wasn't done by an animal. The wounds don't match centaur weaponry either.

Perhaps an experienced scavenger of these lands would know what to make of this.
79229.title: Highway Robbery

79235.completion: You need something? Make it quick.
79235.objectives: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
79235.text:
I've found a couple of scenes like you describe, $N. Always camps of humans and dwarves. Rumor among the caravans is a group of Horde marauders did it. Seems likely given the victims, and how brutal the attacks were.

Apparently the bandits fled Desolace once an Alliance marshal got hot on their trail.

If you're looking to track one of 'em down, I'd check Booty Bay. Ports always have shady characters coming and going. You might catch one trying to get a boat to somewhere.
79235.title: On the Lam

79236.completion: Ah, that's the stuff. Now, where was I?
79236.objectives: Bring a Cherry Grog to Tokal, in Booty Bay, to hear the rest of her story.
79236.text:
You with the marshal? No, you don't look like it.

The rumors you've heard are only half true. Yes, we were pillaging human and dwarven camps, but we weren't doing it for the Horde. We were privately employed.

I'll tell you the whole story if you buy me some grog.
79236.title: Cherry for Your Thoughts?

79242.completion: <Inside of the cache, you find a small box, along with some coin.>
79242.objectives: Find Illari Duskfeather on the coast of Arathi Highlands, and get access to her cache of stolen loot.
79242.progress: <Using Illari's key, you unlock the cache.>
79242.text:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout on the coast of Arathi.
79242.title: No Honor Among Thieves

79358.completion: <Hmmph... the large tauren snorts as he reads the parchment.>$B$BOne things certain... whoever this note is from is right about their preparations going unseen. We've been too busy dealing with the centaur and harpies to send out wind riders to patrol the canyon and bluffs.$B$BYou have our gratitude for alerting us to this threat, but we might still need further assistance.
79358.objectives: Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
79358.text:
Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, $N. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.
79358.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

7936.completion: Here you go, here you go! A prize fit for a king! Congratulations to you, my friend!$B$BIf you have more tickets you'd like to turn in, then please let me know! For as long as the Darkmoon Faire is here, I'll redeem your tickets.
7936.title: 50 Tickets - Last Year's Mutton

79360.completion: <You hand the note to Bath'rah who reads it over and gives a half hearted chuckle.>$B$BAh so it be true mon... I too have sensed much unrest in the elemental plane and dis must be one of the causes.$B$BTo flood all da Thousand Needles would take a great storm and many lives be lost.$B$BI t'ink I got just da t'ing for ya, but it won't come easy.
79360.objectives: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
79360.progress: Danger? There's been no reports of anything like that. And our wind riders are far too busy to spend their time chasing ghost stories.
79360.text:
Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.

The quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.
79360.title: Elemental Aid

79361.completion: Oh yes, yes. We be cookin' now.
79361.objectives: Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79361.progress: Ah, you be gettin' a bit dusty out der?
79361.text:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79362.completion: Let's get ready to rumble, ya?
79362.objectives: Find Grant's Mace on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery then return to Sirra Von'Indie in Darkshire for more information.
79362.progress: You' legs be lookin' a wobbly der. De ground be shakin?
79362.text:
A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.

With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.
79362.title: Grant's Shield

79363.completion: Shake dat sludge off, we almost done.
79363.objectives: Defeat 7 Defias Night Blades and 7 Defias Enchanters in Addle's Stead then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
79363.text:
A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes.

With Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.
79363.title: Silvia's Sword

79364.completion: Knew I could count on you.
79364.objectives: Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79364.progress: We need a larger vial and one of crystal clarity to contain these elements.
79364.text:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a shaman who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful shaman like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.
79364.title: Eyes on the Sky

79365.completion: Our wind riders have found something, but they have been unable to get close enough to assess the situation. Were you able to find anything that might help us?
79365.objectives: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.
79365.text: Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.$B$BNow go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.
79365.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings

79366.completion: The rumbling ground fell silent and in my heart I knew you had saved us. You have our gratitude, $N.$B$BPlease accept one of these gifts as a token of our appreciation.
79366.objectives: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
79366.text:
Now that you have the twisted totems, we must wield them to summon forth the corrupted elementals the quilboar are calling upon. Defeat them to cleanse these lands and put an end to the Razormane's abominable ritual then report back to Rau Cliffrunner with your success.

You should begin your clensing at the steam pools to the west. That area is rich with each of the elements. But be careful, $N. The quilboar will not sit idly while you interrupt their plans.
79366.title: Heed My Call

7939.title: More Dense Grinding Stones

7942.title: More Thorium Widgets

7943.completion: Thanks again, $N. Here are your tickets!
7943.title: More Bat Eyes

79442.completion: Tell ya what. No more tricks, no more games. I got somet'in you'd be interested in.$B$BTrade me dat eye and I give you here this mighty fine rune that be ready to teach you new tricks.$B$BWhat ya say?
79442.objectives: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
79442.progress: Ahh! Looks like ye made it back in one piece there. Now tell me how did de potion do?$B$BWell 'tis a good thing I had faith in ya. Cuz dat potion be nothing but a mighty fine punch bru'dah. Much tastier than it be effective against those storms.$B$BNow, now... don't be angry wit me. All ya needed was a little encouragement. T'ings turned out how they was always meant to.$B$BBut since you's here... I did notice that mighty fine eye you be holdin...
79442.text: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old shaman in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.
79442.title: The Tempest's Weapons

79482.completion: Y-y-you can h-h-hear me! Thank the b-b-bottom line!$B$BI'm not really a s-s-snowman - my n-n-name is Sacks, and I w-w-work for the Ironforge b-b-branch of Smokywood Pastures... I g-g-got sent out here to look for a m-m-missing package, when I was attacked by a c-c-creature I have never seen b-b-before!$B$BSo v-v-very cold...
79482.objectives: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
79482.text: Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.$B$BWe're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it! Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.$B$BSee if both are out there, safe and sound!
79482.title: Stolen Winter Veil Treats

79492.completion: You did it! Huzzah!$B$BMetzen flew back into Greatfather Winter's stables - yes Metzen can really fly - just a little while ago! The dust worked like a charm; I knew it would. You've saved the Feast of Winter Veil as well as Smokywood Pastures from disaster. Thank you, $N.$B$BListen... because of what you've done here, I want you to have this. It's something VERY special; if you have a mount, I think you'll get a kick out of it. Happy Winter Veil!
79492.objectives: Find Metzen the Reindeer. 79492.progress: $N! Were the notes in the satchel I gave you enough information to locate Metzen? I hate to think of that those cruel thugs might do to him... but there's no way we can afford to pay such an exorbitant ransom!

The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter.

Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.
79624.title: Anyone Can Cook

79731.completion: A magic fountain hidden in the jungle? What a story, $N!$B$BThat gives me an idea for another chapter in my book! Let's see, where did I put that manuscript...
79731.objectives: Solve the riddle of the scroll. Once you've done that, Hemet Nesingwary might like to hear the tale.
79731.text:

When Zul'Kunda's fountain runs with the waters of the holy spring, the gods grant their blessing.

79974.objectives: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.
79974.text:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974.title: Wet Job

79975.completion: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.
79975.objectives: Water spray dampens the air, the view is incredible.
79975.text:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975.title: Eagle's Fist

79976.completion: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.
79976.objectives: Whoever was here, you just missed them.
79976.text:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976.title: This Must Be The Place

79980.completion: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.
79980.text: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.title: Scramble

8114.completion: Very good work, $N! An excited scout came to me with a report of your exploits. We in the League of Arathor are very pleased!$B$BYou are swiftly becoming a local hero among the soldiers in the League, and today's deed once again proves your sterling reputation.
8114.objectives: Enter Arathi Basin, capture and control four bases at the same time, and then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.
8114.progress: You have not yet taken four bases, $N. Return to Arathi Basin and do as you have been tasked!
8114.text: $N, you have taken the battle of Arathi Basin to our enemies and earned great honors in that field of battle. You have shown us your worth as a $C, and you have shown our enemies that we will not submit to their villainy!$B$BBecause of your proven value to us, I have a difficult task for you. I want you to take and hold at least four of the bases in Arathi Basin. If you can do that, then we will not only secure critical resources, we will show the Horde our dominance!$B$BGo, $N, and good fortune.
8114.title: Control Four Bases

8115.completion: You did it! You took all of the bases! Well done, $N!$B$BThere were those who doubted your chances, but I knew you could do it. Thank you, and know that the League of Arathor holds you in high regard, just as the Defilers of the Forsaken must fear the very mention of your name!
8115.objectives: Control 5 bases in Arathi Basin at the same time, then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.
8115.progress: You have not yet completed your mission, $N. It is difficult, but my faith in you is strong.
8115.text: $N, battling for the resources of Arathi Basin is a bloody undertaking. Your services to the League of Arathor are are needed as they are appreciated.$B$BAnd we have one more task for you.$B$BThe League wishes to make one strong push against the Defilers' occupation of Arathi Basin. We want them driven out of every strategic point on the battlefield!$B$BIt will not be easy, but if anyone can get it done, it is you.
8115.title: Control Five Bases

8121.completion: Good work, $N! Your latest actions in Arathi Basin were quite difficult, and so their successes are quite praiseworthy. The League of Arathor must be reeling from the last skirmishes in the basin, licking their wounds and, let us hope, rethinking their choice to fight here.
8121.objectives: Hold four bases at the same time in Arathi Basin, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
8121.progress: Return to Arathi Basin, $N, and perform the task for which you were sent to do! Capture and hold four bases!
8121.text: $N, as the battles over Arathi Basin rage, news of your actions have reached many ears. You are highly regarded among us, which gives me confidence that you will accomplish the mission I now have for you.$B$BIt is time to send a message to the League of Arathor. We must show them that their holdings in Arathi Basin are tenuous and quickly lost. We will show them this by holding, all at once, four strategic points in Arathi Basin.$B$BSucceed in this, $N, and earn great respect among the Defilers.
8121.title: Take Four Bases

8122.completion: The cries of the Alliance as you and your compatriots attacked them could be heard even from here, $N. I can almost pity them for the pain and fear you delivered to their ranks. Almost, but not quite.$B$BYour value to the Defilers is without question. Your deeds in Arathi Basin have been most impressive, and have echoed among the chambers of Varimathras... and the Dark Lady herself.
8122.objectives: Hold five bases in Arathi Basin at the same time, then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
8122.text: It is difficult to see, so deep we are in the conflict, but our spies report a weakening in the League of Arathor's resolve. We must use this window and strike a brutal blow against them! Return to Arathi Basin and throw yourself against our foes. Curse them and kill them and control all five strategic bases! Send their soldiers screaming and bleeding from the front lines, with stories of your cruelty on their mewling lips.$B$BDo this, and score a great victory for the Defilers.
8122.title: Take Five Bases

81570.completion: That's a good blade. It has a good swing. It's a good swing blade. Thank you. Thank you, thank you, thank you!!! Now I want to try it....$B$BLater. I'll try it later. But like I was saying... thanks.
81570.objectives: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
81570.text: I have cutting to do. I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade. A certain blade...$B$BSome people call it a moonsteel broadsword. I call it a swing blade.$B$BYou help me? Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.$B$BBut don't sleep on this. What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
81570.title: Jarl Needs a Blade

Morphaz dwells deep in Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in Swamp of Sorrows.$B$BIf you wish to defeat him, you must not go alone. The drake has made its home deep in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in the Swamp of Sorrows.$B$BGather your friends and venture to his lair. 8253.completion: Incredible. The shard has grown as it absorbed the drake's energy over the long years.$B$BThere is no more I can ask of you now. My full ability to forge the arcane has returned with this shard. My first creation is yours, $N, and you have but to choose...
8253.objectives: Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
8253.progress: Have you slain my old nemesis?
8253.text: There is a green drake deep in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar by the name of Morphaz.$B$BYears ago, he overwhelmed me in a bold ambush and consumed my apprentice whole. While the loss of an apprentice is not unknown to me, this particular one carried an arcane shard of unsurpassed size and quality.$B$BYou must gather powerful allies and delve into the temple. Destroy Morphaz and recover the arcane shard from his ageless stomach.
8253.title: Destroy Morphaz

8257.completion: You have slain Morphaz and carried his blood to us... It will take a lifetime to undo what has happened here, but you have given us the means to do it.

8257.progress: Do you have the blood of Morphaz?

There is no doubt his blood is potent for our needs.$B$BA courier from the Cenarion Circle will take the parts you have already collected while you gather the last. Summon your allies and seek out the drake's lair in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar. Bring his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
8257.title: Blood of Morphaz

8258.completion: This is a victory to savor, $N! The demise of Darkreaver should restore the fragile fetters that anchor the spirit realm.$B$BYou have far exceeded what was asked of you, even when you had no notion of reward or compensation. You are truly a $C of worth, my friend.$B$BI know that acting to preserve the spirit realm should be thanks enough, but please - accept this simple gift with my thanks.
8258.objectives: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him.$B$BBring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.

This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.$B$BUse the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions. Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear. $N, bring me his head! Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!

Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
8368.title: Battle of Warsong Gulch

If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, $N.

8413.completion: It's about time this troll got a full night's rest! The spirit totem will watch over me.$B$BI been a long time collectin' things, maybe you want somethin' for all your trouble?
8413.objectives: Bring the voodoo feathers to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
8413.text: The spirit totem just isn't enough. We be needin' some voodoo magic to make it work jus' right.$B$BThe trolls in the sunken temple have feathers strong with voodoo magics. Go there and kill Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Then we have magic enough for a real spirit totem.
8413.title: Da Voodoo

8418.completion: This is excellent, $N. I would say I am surprised, but I knew without question that you wouldn't let us down.$B$BIt is my honor to bestow one of the Holy Mightstones to you. Use it well.
8418.objectives: Bring the voodoo feathers to Ashlam Valorfist.
8418.progress: Have you slain the wretched trolls?
8418.text: Now we must combine the inert scourgestones and create a weapon to shatter the ranks of undead. This is no trivial task, $N. Only the trolls of the sunken temple carry the kind of rare magic able to turn the evil of something against itself.$B$BIn the temple, the trolls are known as Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Do not feel remorse for their corrupt souls... they are not without evil.
8418.title: Forging the Mightstone

8425.completion: At last I can feel the cold touch of steel again, even if only for a moment.
8425.objectives: Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
8425.progress: Are you back so soon? Time is not the same to me any more, perhaps it has indeed been a long journey for you...
8425.text: Your honor has brought some peace to me. It is only right that I offer you something in return.$B$BMy weapons and armor were splendid in life, and yet they are of no use to me now. They would be better served in your possession.$B$BTravel to the sunken temple and destroy the troll guardians Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. They carry magic feathers that can reform my physical body long enough to grant you a reward.
8425.title: Voodoo Feathers

8458.objectives: Bring a Shadowstalker Scalp to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
8458.text: I believe I can find this demon lord given the proper reagents.$B$BIf he is indeed as powerful as I suspect, I will need items gathered from deadly creatures. But you act in the Warchief's name, so I am sure you will accept my task.$B$BFirst, I will have to break any wards he has against scrying. For this, I will need the scalp from a satyr--but not any satyr. The scalp must come from a Hatefury shadowstalker.$B$BSearch for them among the ancient ruins in the northeast of Desolace.
8458.title: <UNUSED>

8484.completion: Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events. Were a lasting peace to be made with these creatures, this would certainly give us an advantage in the affairs of Kalimdor... one that the Night Elves cannot support on their own. I will notify the other leaders of the Alliance of this immediately, and further diplomats will be dispatched!$B$BAs for you, $N... you have shown courage in both diplomacy and in action. I thank you, as does the whole of the Alliance.
8484.objectives: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
8484.progress: $C, you are welcomed in my domain. Ironforge should always be considered a home to a hero such as yourself. Now, what business do you have with me?
8484.text: Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, $N. If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.$B$BPlease - take this offering to the dwarven king that resides in a mountain of iron; I believe you call this city Ironforge. In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Alliance. It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Alliance's efforts in brokering peace.
8484.title: The Brokering of Peace

8485.completion: Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events. 8485.objectives: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
8485.progress: The warchief's greetings are bestowed upon you, $C. Your deeds make the Horde grow stronger in these troubling times. Now, what business do you have with me?
8485.text: Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, $N. In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Horde. It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Horde's efforts in brokering peace.

856.objectives: Continue down the road from Camp Taurajo.$B$BTurn left at the T intersection and continue North.$B$BFollow the path to the Ancestral Sage outside the Crossroads.
856.text: Though you have reached the Barrens, your journey is not complete. You must continue on to the Crossroads, where you are needed most.$B$BFollow the road as you were, and turn left where the path gives you the choice. Follow it North until you see the walls of the Crossroads.$B$BJust before you enter, you should see the Ancestral Sage, he will have words of wisdom for you.
856.title: <UNUSED>

8579.completion: I see that you're no ordinary mortal, $N. Your chances against the Old God, however infinitely small, are greater than ours at this point. After all, while he expects dragons at his doorstep, he is not prepared for someone like you.$B$BJust as Anachronos and Staghelm defeated the Qiraji a thousand years ago through the alliance of mortal and dragon races, we too shall form a pact. Gain the trust of the Bronze Dragonflight and you'll gain our trust. Only then we shall make a true champion out of you.
8579.title: Mortal Champions

8595.completion: You continue to serve us well, $N. Our pact remains in place.
8595.title: Mortal Champions

86574.completion: You found the missing shipment?$B$BOh, I had no idea that the courier didn't make it. That is... a tragic state of affairs...$B$BI'll put these supplies to good use to make sure that her loss is not in vain.
86574.objectives: Collect 6 Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.
86574.progress: I hope that shipment comes soon...
86574.text:
<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
86574.title: Stonetalon Supply Run

86576.completion: Ah, you have brought sunstones that the harpies collect! The harpies love to gather objects that are shiny, but they do not know the true value of the stones. By capturing the dazzling light of the sun, these stones reflect its majesty and allow us to adorn our shrines and homes with tiny motes of light in its honor. The moon, too, illuminates them with its silver beauty at night.$B$BThese stones remind us of the connection we have to the lights of the skies.
86576.progress: I have important matters to consider, $C. Be quick.
86576.text:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
86576.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

86585.completion: You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.$B$BI'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
86585.objectives: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.progress: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585.text:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.title: Banner of the Fallen

86613.completion: Our tools!$B$BWhen the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!
86613.objectives: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
86613.progress: We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!
86613.text: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
86613.title: Excavation Tools

86614.completion: My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good!$B$BThis'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.
86614.objectives: Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.
86614.progress: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?
86614.text: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
86614.title: Silver of the Waves

86667.completion: This jar is for me?$B$BSnow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!$B$BA pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.$B$BWell, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
86667.objectives: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.
86667.text:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667.title: Snowbound

86757.objectives: Bring 6 Jagged Orc Swords and 4 Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
86757.text:
Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
86757.title: Slowing the Orc Advance

86758.completion: Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!$B$BOh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?
86758.objectives: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.text:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.title: Twisting the Knife

86776.completion: Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!
86776.objectives: Bring 10 Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
86776.text:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776.title: Ingredients for the Forge

86784.completion: Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.$B$BI have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.
86784.objectives: Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
86784.text:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784.title: Sticks and Bones

87288.completion: Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.$B$BHere, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.
87288.objectives: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
87288.progress: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288.text:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
87288.title: Soft Saber Pelts

87318.completion: Corma sent you? That's great news!$B$BWhen the Dark Irons ambushed us, we were separated, and I hit my head and couldn't tell which direction I was going. I wound up here and I've been living out of the supplies in my bag for the last few days. Now that you've made it past the Dark Irons, though, it may be possible for me to make my escape.$B$BI just have to gather my things and take a moment to catch my senses, and I'll figure out a way to escape!$B$BShe never gave up on me. What a lovely heart.
87318.text:
Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!

I managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!

Please, if you see any sign of her, let me know!
87318.title: Hearts of the Lost

87491.completion: That was quite a pyrotechnic display! I don't think I've seen anything quite like it!$B$BGlad the fire elemental, uh, ran outta steam, as it were. Coulda been bad if it had decided to go after the rest of us instead of those Dark Irons!
87491.objectives: Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.
87491.text:
Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!

Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!

No Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!

Let me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!
87491.title: Spark of Freedom

87760.completion: This has been a long journey, Orangequake, but it was worth it.$B$BAt long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace.$B$BThank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.
87760.objectives: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
87760.progress: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!
87760.text:
I have received word back from Darnassus, $N!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
87760.title: Holy Diver

8784.completion: An exceptional find, $N. Simply marvelous! This will definitely give us some insight into our enemy's twisted minds.
8784.objectives: Take the Ancient Qiraji Artifact to the dragons hiding near the entrance of the temple.
8784.progress: You're glowing! I know what that means...
8784.text: You have discovered an ancient Qiraji artifact! Perhaps one of the dragons near the entrance of the temple would have a use for this relic.
8784.title: Secrets of the Qiraji

8801.completion: We will leave this place on our own, Lord $N - once we are certain that the evil within has been wholly destroyed. Your journey of legend is almost at an end.
8801.objectives: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Caelastrasz in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.
8801.progress: <Caelastrasz kneels before you.>$B$BLord $N, you have freed us of its grasp.
8801.text: The walls of Ahn'Qiraj tremble. A force of evil, older than the world itself, has been destroyed.$B$BAs you look at the remnants of the colossal abomination your heart nearly freezes. Even in death you can feel the legacy of C'Thun's evil around you.$B$BYou have done what was thought to be impossible.$B$BYou grab at an eye stalk of the fiend, stowing it safely in your pack.$B$BTake the Eye of C'Thun to the dragons in the next chamber.
8801.title: C'Thun's Legacy

8802.completion: The Master has left these for you, champion. From the timeless cache: A collection of artifacts spanning thousands of years - the choice is yours.
8802.objectives: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
8802.text: To the Caverns of Time you go, $gLord:Lady; $N. Anachronos awaits your return. Give him the eye of C'Thun as he will undoubtedly wish to place it in his master's collection.
8802.title: The Savior of Kalimdor

88756.completion: Ach, that's a load off me mind. At least the Dark Irons won't be able to roll a bomb-cart into our wagons... or lob 'em in a trebuchet... or roll 'em down the hill at us... or feed 'em tae slimes and then let the slimes loose near are camp and set 'em on fire.$B$BNow we just have tae make sure the powder stays dry!$B$BThanks!
88756.objectives: Retrieve 3 Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.
88756.progress: This war against the Dark Irons just keeps going on and on!
88756.text:
The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
88756.title: Bring Back a Bang

88757.completion: You got my book! And my waterskin! And my necklace! Oh, good fortune finds me today... thank you so much.$B$BI'd better make sure everything is intact!
88757.objectives: Bring back Essene's Necklace, Essene's Spellbook, and Essene's Waterskin.
88757.progress: Just relacing my boots! Any luck getting past those Dark Irons and finding my things?
88757.text:
While I was fleeing from those Dark Irons, I wound up dropping lots of my gear!

It looks like I lost... my green leather waterskin, my spellbook, my necklace, and... well I need these things!

If you can find them while I repack and catch my breath, that would be a great help.
88757.title: Accessories of the Lost

88758.completion: She's alive? She's alive!$B$BLet me see this note... "Dear Corma..." mhmm... oh, blessed day! Thank the Light!$B$BI can never thank you enough for reuniting us. I can't wait until she makes it back here!$B$BYou've done a wonderful service for us both.
88758.objectives: Bring Essene's note back to Corma Villard.
88758.progress: Have you found any sign of her?
88758.text:
I just need to finish repacking, and I can get out of here!

If you'll do me one last favor, here--take this note to Corma. It'll let her know that I'm alive and I'm on my way!
88758.title: Sentiments of the Lost

8876.completion: Ah, very well. Here are your recipes, $N, and my Elune bless you.
8876.title: Small Rockets

8879.completion: Very well - I accept these coins of ancestry. Here are your recipes, $N. May you use them to spread Elune's glory!
8879.title: Large Rockets

8880.completion: Here you are, $N. Take these recipes and learn their secrets. I bid you fortune, and I look forward to seeing your magnificent creations.
8880.title: Cluster Rockets

8881.completion: Thank you, $N. Here is the recipe for large cluster rockets. May your products bring joy and luck to all those who gaze up them.
8881.title: Large Cluster Rockets

8945.completion: Thank you for rescuing me... I feared for my life. Please accept this as a small token of my gratitude.$B$BAnthion is... no... he can't be...
8945.objectives: Go into Stratholme and rescue Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.
8945.text: I'll provide you the information you ask for, $N. But more pressing matters are at hand.$B$BMy beloved wife has been taken prisoner by Rivendare's undead scum.$B$BI strongly objected to her joining the Argent Dawn's foolish crusade, yet that's not of importance anymore. You must finish what I attempted to do, you must rescue Ysida from the clutches of the Baron!
8945.title: Dead Man's Plea

898.completion: And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!$B$BYour heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, $N.
898.objectives: Safely escort Gilthares Firebough back to Captain Brightsun in Ratchet.
898.text: Finally! Someone to rescue me!$B$BI can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.$B$BMe! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.$B$BEnough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
898.title: Free From the Hold

9.completion: Good work, friend. You have earned your pay well. Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
9.objectives: Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.
9.progress: Ah, I see you're back! I hope you've been hard at work clearing those fields of those Harvest Watchers. Have you killed twenty yet?
9.text: Look at what has happened to this place! These lands were once occupied by good farm folk. But the damned thieves have driven them all off. Not me, though! But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.$B$BIf you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them. Come back when you're done for your pay. If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9.title: The Killing Fields

90.completion: Very nice work, $N! Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!
90.objectives: Gather 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and return to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
90.progress: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet? How about the herbs from Felicia in Stormwind?
90.text: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite! Sure, I can make you some. But first I'll need the supplies. Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem. Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.
90.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

9000.objectives: Give Deliana your Beaststalker's Cap and Beaststalker's Tunic.
9000.text: That's an amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
9000.title: Saving the Best for Last

9014.objectives: Give Mokvar your Magister's Crown and Magister's Robes.
9014.text: A truly amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
9014.title: Saving the Best for Last

905.completion: So you've been to the nests and placed the feathers of your prey within them. That took a fair portion of courage, no doubt about it.$B$BDo you feel a little tougher, $N? Because you look tougher now then when you first came here. I guess the Barrens is doing its job.
905.objectives: Kill Sunscale raptors and collect their feathers. Use the feathers on the 3 Scytheclaw nests. Return to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
905.progress: Have you been to the nests, $N?
905.text: Now, $N, the hunt deepens. Now you must defeat your prey, and then find your way to its lair.$B$BHunt the sunscale raptors to the south. Slay them and remove the feathers they wear. Place the feathers on the scytheclaw nests southwest of the Stagnant Oasis. Show their brethren you do not fear them!
905.title: The Angry Scytheclaws

9053.completion: At last, the toxin can be created in full. I dare not require you to inflict it upon the creature again, as I have asked too much already.$B$BYou have my thanks and respect. May you be well in your travels, $N.
9053.objectives: Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
9053.text: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.$B$BIf we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there. The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.$B$BReturn to me when this is done.
9053.title: A Better Ingredient

909.objectives: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
909.text: The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe. You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy. Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about. The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.$B$BIf anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring. He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
909.title: Baron Aquanis

90902.completion: Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances.$B$BBe well and walk in the light once more, $C.
90902.objectives: Heal 5 Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
90902.progress: Mastery of the light will return, in time.
90902.text:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902.title: Rediscovering the Light

91208.completion: Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.$B$BI will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, $N.
91208.objectives: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
91208.text:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
91208.title: Coming to Terms

91209.completion: Welcome aboard, $C. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training.$B$BWhen you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.$B$BGo with the light, $C.
91209.objectives: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
91209.text:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
91209.title: Continue Your Training

91282.completion: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Tyr's Watch, brother.
91282.objectives: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
91282.text:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery at Northface Rock. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282.title: A Second Home

91285.completion: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.
91285.objectives: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
91285.text:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91294.completion: Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.$B$BMy name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.$B$BThere's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.
91294.objectives: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
91294.progress: Welcome to Bandarion Keep, $C. It's always good to see a new face.
91294.text:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, $N. May the light be your guide.
91294.title: Touring the Grounds

91316.completion: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.
91316.objectives: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
91316.progress: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.
91316.text:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
91316.title: Making Repairs

91317.completion: Excellent work, $N. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.$B$BI suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.
91317.objectives: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
91317.progress: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.
91317.text:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317.title: The Tarnished

914.completion: You have done it, $N. You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang. My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the Barrens from a cursed future.$B$BI thank you, $N. I thank you for myself, for the druids of Thunder Bluff, and for the land.
914.objectives: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
914.progress: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, $N. Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
914.text: The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration. They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.$B$BThe Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem. Even now their faces haunt me! Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.$B$BGo, $N. You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
914.title: Leaders of the Fang

915.completion: Mmmmmmmmm! I love their strawberry ice cream! If there's one thing Tigule and Foror know to do, it's make ice cream!$B$BThank you very much $N - this is the best treat ever!
915.objectives: Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule and Foror's brand ice cream.
915.progress: I wish they'd make more flavors of ice cream other than strawberry, but I guess I'm lucky that strawberry is my favorite!
915.text: ICE CREAM! Oh please please please could you get me some ice cream?! Strawberry is my favorite flavor, and there's no better strawberry ice cream in the world than Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream! It's my favorite ice cream in the whole wide world!$B$BI had it once a long time ago when I was at the Shimmering Flats race track, but I heard that they might be selling them in town now! Please? Pretty please? With Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream on top??!?!
915.title: You Scream, I Scream...

91723.completion: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...
91723.objectives: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91723.text:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723.title: Delicate Instruments

91724.completion: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, $N.
91724.objectives: Kill 6 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91724.text:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.
This is most frustrating, $N. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
91724.title: Delicate Instruments

91725.completion: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!
91725.objectives: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
91725.text:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732.completion: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
91732.objectives: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
91732.progress: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732.text: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732.title: Good Steel

91733.completion: You look a bit damp, $N. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.
91733.objectives: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
91733.text:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.
Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort - do you think you could find them for me?
91733.title: Downstream

91736.completion: The machine dispenses a clear liquid into a bottle...
91736.title: Applejack Still

91738.completion: Do my eyes deceive me? I haven't seen a drop of Thunder Applejack in months!$BThis should put a smile on the troops' faces. You have my thanks, $C!
91738.title: An Apple Treat

91740.completion: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, $C. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.
91740.objectives: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
91740.text: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
91740.title: Croaky's Head

91741.completion: Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!$B$BThanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
91741.objectives: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
91741.progress: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743.completion: Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.$B$BBut there's still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743.objectives: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.progress: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743.text: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.title: Rascally Rodents

91745.completion: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
91745.objectives: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
91745.text: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745.title: Mining Consultant

91746.completion: So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, $N!$B$BLet me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.
91746.objectives: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91746.text: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
91746.title: Elmpaw's Head

91751.completion: Excellent work collecting these pelts, $C. You have a real talent for hunting.
91751.objectives: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91751.progress: Any luck with those wolf pelts?
91751.text: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91752.completion: Thank you for returning these stolen books, $N. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.$B$BYou're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
91752.objectives: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
91752.progress: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752.text:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752.title: The Big Picture

91753.completion: Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, $N. Remember this.
91753.objectives:
Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
91753.text:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753.title: An Enchanting Lesson

91758.completion: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.
91758.objectives: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
91758.text:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.title: Follow That Kobold!

91772.completion: What's this, $N? Tracking kobolds?$B$BWell, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.$B$BGood work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
91772.objectives: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
91772.progress: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772.text:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775.completion: I applaud your diligence, $N. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine.$B$BYou can keep that book bag!
91775.objectives: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
91775.progress: Have you found all the books yet?
91775.text:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.title: Book Return

91777.completion: Oh, $N! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.
91777.objectives: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
91777.progress: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777.text:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777.title: Rare Books

91858.completion: Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, $C.
91858.objectives: Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.
91858.text:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858.title: Diplomatic Incident

91859.completion: I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?
91859.objectives: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
91859.text:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859.title: A Curious Pair

91860.completion: <The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?$B$BThis will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>
91860.objectives: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
91860.text:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860.title: A Grim Fate

91861.completion: You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me?$B$BTime is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!
91861.objectives: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.
