While we cannot use these pieces directly, we do salvage them for scraps. The most magical of the armaments go to me, as I can disenchant them and make use of the mysterious remnants to enchant our weapons, particularly those of our windchasers.

I am in need of Greater Mystic Essences if I am to supply our next raiding party with worthwhile equipment.
92755.title: Mysterious Mysticism

92812.completion: I will add these to our collection. Our power grows thanks to your contributions, though we have a long way to go if we are to overcome the Magram Clan.
92812.title: Economic Warfare

92814.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92814.text:
My mate, Halea, is tasked with ensuring our armaments are empowered with appropriate magical energy.

The whole concept of enchanting is far beyond my understanding, but as the centaur whose job is to keep our village well supplied and equipped, I know that Halea is often behind on her duties--to no fault of her own.

I would like to gift her some simple clothes to practice her craft on. I see some adventurers wandering through sandstorms with simple facemasks. Could you get me a few of those?
92814.title: I Need a Tailor

92817.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92817.text:
Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.

I have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.

Outsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
92817.title: Leather Technique

92818.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 2 Massive Iron Axes to Grolkar in the Magram Village in Desolace.
92818.text:
WE NEED MORE WEAPONS.

MORE. WEAPONS.

HOW ELSE IS THE MAGRAM GOING TO SMASH PUNY GELKIS?

I WANT TO SEE WHAT YOU CAN MAKE, OUTSIDER. BRING ME AXES. BIG, NO, MASSIVE ONES.

HURRY UP.
92818.title: Big, No, MASSIVE Iron Axes

92819.completion: I don't know what to say, $N. To think that Stormwind would put their military ambitions over the livelihood of their people...
92819.text: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
92819.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92834.completion: The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.$B$B<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>$B$B...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.
92834.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
92834.progress: The mark of a leader is the ability to admit when they were wrong. I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
92834.text:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
92834.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840.completion: It would not have been my preference to spill Windshaper blood but the blame for this pointless conflict rests solely on their shoulders. We sought to peacefully gather information, and they responded with violence.$B$BUnfortunately, word has spread and the Windshapers are already calling it a 'massacre'. They wouldn't dare to retaliate here in Valanaar, but they will certainly not forget.$B$B$N, you have been of tremendous aid to the High Order. Thank you.
92840.objectives: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
92840.progress: It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.$B$BThey see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?
92840.text:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.title: Catching Wind

92841.completion: So the rumors are true. Unfortunate that Warug has had you running around with frivolous tasks. At least you proved your worth.$B$BPeer down into the valley below, what do you see? Bones and bodies. Roaming undead. And the Twin Goliaths.$B$BThis place was cursed long before our arrival, and I suspect it will remain as such for many generations to come. Our clan was the first to brave the horrors below, and ours will be the only one to claim its power.$B$BAre you as eager as I to rule over all of Desolace?
92841.objectives: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.
92841.text:
It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it!

Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul.

You will know when you get there.
You will know when you see him.
If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know.

And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.
92841.title: Valley of Bones

92844.completion: <Orgrul begins to count the bones, but begins to skip numbers as they gain a second digit and eventually loses count. He tries a second time, but glares your direction partway through when your expression contorts while observing.>$B$BBah. I will count them later. This looks like enough. You had best not be deceiving me.$B$BI will hold onto these.
92844.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 426 Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul south of the Magram Village in Desolace.
92844.progress: For every bone short you are for the task, I will take one of yours to make up the difference.
92844.text:
Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand.

Those reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic.

If you think I intend to start you off with a challenging task, think again. For now, go into the Valley of Bones and fetch some bones for me. I am sure you can handle that.
92844.title: Mountain of Bones

92846.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay Outcast Necromancers within the Valley of Bones.
92846.text:
Have you noticed the puny centaur stomping about around here? Those are of Gelkis descent.

We Magram have already established a foothold deeper into the canyon. When the Gelkis took notice of our presence here, some among them chose to follow in our footsteps. I know not whether they wish to join us or attempt to overthrow us, but I do know that their clanmates have sentenced them all to exile.

They're lone wolves meddling in powers that do not belong to them. I want them dead.
92846.title: Outcast Necromancers

92847.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Petrified Bark and 3 Imbued Tears back to Orgrul.
92847.text:
Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal.

I think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.
92847.title: Corrupting Tears

92849.completion: Th... thank you, stranger. I was walking down the road on my way back to Valanaar when a looming shadow appeared overhead. I turned to look and saw a massive, terrible beast bearing down at me from the sky. I tried to run, but I was hit hard and the world went black.$B$BI think its fair to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its young.
92849.text: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>
92849.title: The Missing Scholar

92850.completion: Well, I confess that I am intensely relieved that Fillion has returned to us. He never was good at minding his surroundings. Always too busy lost in thought, or with his nose in a book.$B$BThank you, $C.
92850.objectives: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.
92850.text:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.
92850.title: The Missing Scholar

92860.completion: I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good mage and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.$B$BYou seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.
92860.objectives: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92860.text:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860.title: In Service of Zephras

92867.objectives: Defeat the Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark intruders in Stromgarde Keep and return to Groundskeeper Lomar.
92867.text:
Our heritage may be crumbling, but this is not our final redoubt. We have more in reserve, and it must remain hidden for its own protection.

Support grows for preserving our remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds. The rabble that have taken up residence in our old kingdom have no notion of the vengeance coming for them.

Drive back the Boulderfist and Syndicate. They must learn Stromgarde is not merely fist, eagle, and stones.
92867.title: Ground to Keep

92871.completion: You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.
92871.objectives: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92871.text:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871.title: In Service of Zephras

92872.objectives: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.
92872.text:
We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls.

Now that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom.

Each season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles.

Take this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.
92872.title: Dutiful Steps

92873.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring 426 Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul.
92873.text:
We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons.

<Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.>

I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it.
92873.title: Proof of Concept

92880.completion: <Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>$B$BThank the winds.
92880.objectives: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92880.text:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $C.
92880.title: Return to Valanaar

92881.completion: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.
92881.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.text:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.title: The High Elder's Request

92893.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and slay 5 Gelkis Captives scattered around the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul after the task is complete.
92893.text:
As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive.

This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.
92893.title: No Mercy for the Weak

92894.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.
92894.text:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894.title: Bone Raising

92909.completion: Thanks a bunch! I'll get to work on an escape plan. In the meantime, take this!
92909.objectives: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.
92909.progress: It's a mess out there, $N! Did you collect the parts I need?
92909.text:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
92909.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92910.objectives: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.
92910.text: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92910.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92911.completion: Here it is, Raton! Should work great. Go give it a try!$B$B...Me? No, I'll stay here. It's starting to feel like home, anyway.
92911.objectives: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.
92911.text:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?
92911.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92947.completion: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.
92947.objectives: Slay 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
92947.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $C.
92947.title: Making Our Move

93034.objectives: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.
93034.text:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, $N. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
93034.title: Valley of Bones

93035.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay 6 Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.
93035.text:
You need not peer far to see the undead shambling about ahead of us, but have you noticed something unusual about them?

They walk on two legs, not four! These skeletons are not even our fallen kin. The Magram must be defiling the bodies of those who died long before the Desolace was our domain. I cannot imagine how they justified turning their backs on Mother Theradras and took to desecrating corpses that have rested here for centuries.

Put the undead to rest, $N.
93035.title: Ravaging Ravagers

93036.completion: Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?$B$BThere is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.
93036.objectives: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
93036.text:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
93036.title: Infiltrating the Cult

93037.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring 1 Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.
93037.text:
While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.

I cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.

$N, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.
93037.title: Outing Outcasts

93041.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
93041.text:
This discovery is devastating for our clan, but it is in our best interest to keep this only to those who need to know. Uthek is one such person who needs to be aware of what is going on here. I suspect she will know how to proceed.

Take this to show her. For good measure, we should also bring evidence of the necromancy itself to her. Find a skull that looks recently cursed. I suspect they may be hoarding them in the maws of one of the goliath's skeletons.
93041.title: Facing the Truth

93044.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring Tears of Theradras back to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
93044.text:
When you return to Nerlokh in the Valley of Bones, it will not be empty-handed.

Go inside the cave at the heart of our village and seek out Mulara. Ask for Tears of Theradras on my behalf. Our supply is low, but it is our best hope against the Magram's foul necromancy!

I will prepare a ritual. We will create a weapon to disrupt their spells.
93044.title: A Cleansing Cry

93045.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and dispel the necromantic curse present on the Accursed Skull. Once successful, report back to Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones.
93045.text:
I have placed the skull you provided alongside several bones I found while awaiting your return. Immediately I saw a sickly light spread from the skull and claim those old bones as its own. I see now why the call of necromancy is so hard to resist.

Do you remember this crystal? It is draenethyst. I know little of its potential, but I believe it can channel Theradras' power. With it, perhaps you can dispel the curse.

The ritual site can be found by the pond just east of the village.
93045.title: Test Your Theory

93058.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue 5 Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.
93058.text:
There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.

$N, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.

You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.
93058.title: Saving Our Own

93062.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and dispel the curses from 8 failed summons throughout the Valley of Bones.
93062.text:
About this staff of yours. I recognize it as one of Uthek's, and you mentioned it was constructed with Theradras' Tears, augmented with a Draenethyst Crystal, and that it can dispel dark magic?

I noticed that there are skeletons stuck just underneath the rocky soil further into the valley. I believe these are failed summons from the Outcast Necromancers, doomed perhaps forever to an existence smothered in dirt.

Laying them to rest again would be good for our cause, and their spirits.
93062.title: Bone Burying

93065.completion: We are as ready as we'll ever be.
93065.objectives: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93065.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065.title: Prepare for Battle

93066.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace.
93066.text:
On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.

This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.
93066.title: Bristleback Retreat

93072.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram clan and slay 2 Outcast Scouts, 6 Outcast Marauders, and 8 Outcast Necromancers then return to Hagiak at the Magram Front.
93072.text:
There is a second centaur village out here, to the southwest. That one belongs to the Gelkis. You expect me to send you over just to spill some blood, right? Good. That had best be your first thought, else I would cast doubt on your allegiance to the Magram!

What are you waiting for? Go! Kill!
93072.title: Long-Term Solutions

93089.completion: It gladdens me to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.$B$BAnsirem has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between the city of Dalaran and Zephras Isle. We've done as much testing as we can, and the time has come for vanguard to depart.
93089.objectives: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93089.text:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, $N.
93089.title: What Comes Next

93090.completion: I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.$B$BMuln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side.
93090.objectives: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93090.text:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, $N.
93090.title: What Comes Next

93122.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and investigate centaur points of interest within Shen'dralas. Then return to Nerlokh at the entrance of Valley of Bones with your findings.
93122.text:
We have all underestimated the power and presence of the Magram clan in this area, but this could prove an advantage.

With so many of their own distracted and their refusal to accept other clans' exiles, who is left to defend the village? What of their Khan?

I need you to go into the valley, deeper than you have gone before, and look around. If the Magram are as well fortified here as they seem, they may have left themselves vulnerable at their village...
93122.title: Checking Things Out

93125.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.
93125.text:
You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help.

I was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent!

Please help.
93125.title: Going Home

93128.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
93128.text:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But $N, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
93128.title: Khan Jehn

93129.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 6 Stolen Supplies back to Hagiak at the Magram Front.
93129.text:
Since you seem overly eager to help our clan, I am sure you would be willing to fetch some supplies while you are over in the Outcast Hideaway.

Felling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too.

When we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees!
93129.title: Threat of Starvation

93159.completion: ...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.$B$BI have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.
93159.objectives: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
93159.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?
93159.title: The Strange Hermit

93160.completion: Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted!$B$BPlease excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.
93160.objectives: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
93160.progress: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!
93160.text:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160.title: The Forest's Bounty

93165.completion: Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.$B$BI suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears bring them here.
93165.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
93165.progress: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.
93165.text:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93172.objectives: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
93172.progress: We can only hope that those poor spirits are able to find peace after being freed from this place.
93172.text:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172.title: Free the Hollows

93173.objectives: Return the Rusty Gadget to The Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest
93173.text: <As the roiling currents that hold the Wind Hollow together begin to dissipate, a small metal device tumbles to the ground at your feet. It appears to be some sort of mechanical gadget. The Strange Hermit mentioned he was still missing some equipment. He might be interested in this.>
93173.title: (UNUSED) The Rusty Gadget

93176.completion: These are simply delightful! Look at the forelegs on this one! The coloring of this one's carapace! Oh, and this one's mandibles!$B$BI didn't take you for an entomologist, but you have quite a keen eye.$B$BPlease, take this. I think he might have taken a liking to you, and I've already catalogued this particular species.$B$BNow, if you'll excuse me, I must return to my research. You've given me much to study!
93176.objectives: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.
93176.progress: I must say though, there's nothing like the thrill of finding new specimens. I used to delight in scrounging for them through all manner of muck and grime, but I rarely get the opportunity these days.$B$BIn that sense, my little brood is both a blessing and a curse. Because they require so much attention, I cannot travel beyond the swamp.
93176.text:
Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.

Do you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.
93176.title: My Little Friends

93188.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and report back to Orgrul near the northern entrance to Valley of Bones.
93188.text:
You have done enough on the front lines. We can handle ourselves.

Tell Orgrul that you have served your purpose. The Magram Front is stronger now, and we have our sights set on the outcast encampment as our next settlement when another fleet of fighters joins the fray.

Well? Get going!
93188.title: Return to Orgrul

93196.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village.
93196.text:
The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.

You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.

Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?

<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>

This is why.
93196.title: Khan Jehn

932.completion: With Lord Melenas laid to rest I can finally move on to other matters. Thank you, $N.
932.objectives: Kill Lord Melenas and bring his head to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
932.progress: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, $N. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
932.text: I must warn you, $N, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.$B$BHe is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.$B$BYou must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
932.title: Twisted Hatred

93224.objectives: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.
93224.text:
It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.

One thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.
93224.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93225.completion: These are beautiful--I underestimated the creativity of the centaur. I never would have imagined that a race so full of brutality and cruelty would be able to appreciate stories told through carvings.$B$BI suppose appreciating them takes way less effort than crafting them. Let me rephrase: I never would have imagined the centaur to be patient enough to carve out so many tales in wood. Where are they getting the wood?$B$BIn any case, speak to me when you are ready to make your delivery.
93225.objectives: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
93225.progress: Have you returned with the totems?
93225.text:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93226.objectives: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
93226.text:
Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.

Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
93226.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

93227.objectives: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
93227.text:
At first glance, I would wager that the Gelkis are struggling. Their numbers are far fewer than the Magram, and I rarely hear of them stomping around from our scouts.

Nonetheless, they are one of the dominant clans in the Desolace and survive to this day. They must be doing something right.

If you want to make peace with the Gelkis, take this tote of totems with you to Gelkis Village far to the southwest. Primitive as they may be, they are likely to have a treasurer of some kind.
93227.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis

93317.completion: Winds bless me this meat looks fantastic!$B$BThank you so much, $C.
93317.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
93317.progress: Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.$B$BNot been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.
93317.text:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93317.title: Crab Season

93318.completion: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.
93318.objectives: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
93318.progress: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.
93318.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93319.completion: Thanks $C. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.
93319.objectives: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93319.progress: These sneakthieves have likely been breaking into our supplies for months. I tried to convince Aonda to put a raid together to clear out that bandit cave for good, but she didn't want to pull the few peacekeepers we have away from the village.$B$BWith the cultists at Falaath Village to the south growing in numbers, I suppose I can't fault her for that.
93319.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319.title: Pilfered Windstones

93320.completion: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.
93320.objectives: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93320.text:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.
93320.title: Tower Defense

93429.objectives: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.
93429.text:
Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.

There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.

Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?
93429.title: Blood of My Blood

93430.objectives: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.
93430.text:
Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!

I was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.

Well, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, $R!
93430.title: Taking the Bait Back

93459.completion: As promised, here is your reward.
93459.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands and return them to Vayn Moonclaw in Shadowgale Forest.
93459.text:
The Al'Aketh cult normally gives this forest a wide berth, fearing the rumors that it is haunted... rumors we are happy to maintain. The Druids of my order wish only to live quiet, peaceful lives here in Shadowgale and they threaten that. 

Many among us are afraid.

I come with an offer. Fight the cultists for us, and bring us the ears of those you kill. We will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to our secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93459.title: More Al'Aketh Ears

93461.completion: Checked in with Rathiril then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Well, at least in the village anyway. What happens out in the wilds stays in the wilds.$B$BNow that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands. I've got a few things that need doing, if you are game for a bit of work?
93461.objectives: Speak with Rathiril Sunlance and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
93461.text:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
93461.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

93464.objectives: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.
93464.text:
Allow me to admit something, $N. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.

I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands. 

At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.

I ask that you find this mage, $R. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.
93464.title: The Visiting Mage

93465.objectives: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.
93465.text:
I suppose it would be more accurate to say I know someone who knows a thing or two about draenethyst.

You see, the warlocks of the Burning Blade have been studying it. It is a substance from beyond the dark portal, so it follows that those involved with darker arts might wish to harness it to their own ends. We cannot allow this, obviously.

The specific warlock you seek is named Gimashi. She can be found atop her tower, which is in a ravine to the southeast. Her notes will have the answers you seek.
93465.title: Notes on Draenethyst

93552.completion: Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade.$B$Bwindstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.
93552.objectives: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
93552.text:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552.title: Harvesting Windstones

93585.objectives: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.
93585.text:
Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!

I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!

However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, $C?
93585.title: This Light of Mine

93663.objectives: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.
93663.text:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.
93663.title: Lost in Transit

93678.objectives: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.
93678.text:
I've prepared a transcription of Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. It appears the shards possess some degree of energy, but a pure sphere of the stuff is vastly more powerful. That seems to be what the Burning Blade was after.

Many of Gimashi's notes allude to portals and demonic summoning rituals. Portals to where, or to summon which demons, I cannot say for sure.

While my answers are not definitive, please take these notes back to the swamp with you. I hope you'll understand if I don't come along.
93678.title: Abridged Notes on Draenethyst

93680.completion: A sewer key? Well, thankfully I am not the one who will be using this.$B$BBut we have work to do before it's safe to use this.
93680.objectives: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
93680.progress: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?
93680.text:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680.title: Key to the City

93735.completion: <Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.>$B$BStorms curse where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now!
93735.objectives: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
93735.text:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735.title: The Broken Construct

93736.completion: Handling these essences fills me with a sense of... deep disquiet. I can almost feel a malevolent, regretful aura emanating from them. It's enough to make me faint.$B$B<Endaria shudders slightly.>$B$BI do not look forward to studying these further.
93736.objectives: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
93736.progress: Shadowgale Forest is a dangerous place. Some even say its haunted. I'm quite sure that I don't believe that, but I do know that its not for the faint hearted, or the unprepared.
93736.text:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93737.completion: Thank you for scavenging these materials. I imagine that some of this wasn't terribly easy to get.$B$BWith these parts I can get the construct up and running again. From there we can just hope that its memory is intact and it can tell us who took its components.
93737.objectives: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
93737.progress: I can't imagine why anyone would want to steal these components from this construct. Other than the gyrozephyr these components have almost no practical application. Even the gyro would be nigh-useless outside of its intended purpose.
93737.text:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.
93737.title: The Broken Construct

93738.completion: Very interesting, so it was the High Order that was responsible for the construct breaking down?$B$BI know Belathaan. He's Valennia Stormfist's cousin and his mother was actually a Windshaper. It's disappointing that he was involved in this.$B$BI need to reflect on this for a moment.
93738.objectives: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
93738.text:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.
93738.title: The Broken Construct

93739.completion: So you have returned. I hope that you learned much in your journey.$B$BIt is my understanding that your people are still establishing themselves in Mulgore. While you wait for them, I'd encourage you to explore the territory around Orgrimmar. The Barrens in particular is always in need of eager adventurers like yourself.
93739.objectives: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
93739.text:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
93739.title: Exploring the Horde

93740.completion: <Ayessa looks shaken and distant as you hand her the windstone charms.>$B$BDon't mind me, $N. Today has merely been... a trying day. Thank you for your service to the windshapers thus far.
93740.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93740.progress: The Al'Aketh have engaged in their bloody zealotry for far too long. This is only the start of the reckoning they face.
93740.text:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.
93740.title: Blood for Blood

93746.completion: Wait--what?! Belathaan... is dead?$B$B<Ayessa listens as you give your account of what occurred.>$B$BThe High Order was meeting with the Al'Aketh to discuss peace? There is no peace with the cult, they are murderous zealots. What was Elaadrin thinking sending Belathaan to treat with them alone?$B$BPay this no mind, $N. You are not at fault for this. The arrogance of the High Order is to blame, yet again. You were merely in the right place at the wrong time.
93746.objectives: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
93746.text:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.
93746.title: A Firm Response

93791.completion: Ah, you must be $N? It is heartening to see young mages eager to learn our ways and history. Come, I will explain the next steps to crafting your spell focus.
93791.objectives: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93791.text:
$N, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.
93791.title: Speak with Belann

93797.completion: Thank you, $N. I can indeed feel the elemental energies in this bough waiting to be harnessed by those that have the gift to do so. This will make an excellent spell focus.$B$BDid this branch sing to you, perhaps? It has often been the case that the branch picks the $C, and not the other way around.
93797.objectives: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93797.progress: Every year that passes in Zephras sees fewer and fewer of those who are gifted with a talent for magic.$B$BI am glad to see young mages such as yourself participate in our oldest traditions to help keep our history and culture alive and well.
93797.text:
It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.
93797.title: Boughs in the Wind

93835.completion: I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.$B$BAnsirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.
93835.objectives: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
93835.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $C.
93835.title: Confront Lorthuna

93836.completion: <Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Ayessa's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>$B$BI need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet and on the timeline of elemental gods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.$B$BThere is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.
93836.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93836.text:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
93836.title: The Fate of Zephras

93926.completion: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, its clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>
93926.objectives: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
93926.text:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!
93926.title: The Western Watch

93927.completion: So they are all dead, then. Storms curse on these cult bastards!$B$BWhile you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.$B$BI have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
93927.objectives: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
93927.progress: What news from the western watch?
93927.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927.title: A Last Request

93928.text:
I need a cookie, see? 

Nyeah!
93928.title: Of Mice and Milk

93948.completion: I... am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.$B$BIt's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.
93948.objectives: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93948.progress: What is that you have for me? Oh... oh no.
93948.text:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
93948.title: Deliver the Signet

93949.completion: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.
93949.objectives: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.
93949.text:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
93949.title: Bugged

93951.completion: It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible.$B$BIf one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.
93951.objectives: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93951.progress: What beautiful things did you bring me?
93951.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951.title: A Little Beauty

93958.objectives: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.
93958.text:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.
93958.title: The Inner Sanctum

93963.completion: Ah, you are back.$B$BI hope your adventures have given you a sense of the scale and wonder of our world. I know it must seem overwhelming to you, but if you are to help your people, you must be prepared for whatever may come your way while you are on Azeroth.$B$BWhile you wait for your order to establish itself in Dalaran, I suggest you turn your attention to the lands around Stormwind. Westfall in particular can always use more strong adventurers to lend them aid, if you are willing.
93963.objectives: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
93963.text:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.title: Exploring the Alliance

940.completion: I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.$B$BI fear my work on Teldrassil shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.$B$BNonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.
940.objectives: Deliver the Inscribed Bark to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
940.progress: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, $C. What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?
940.text: The forest whispers of your feats of valor, $N. As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch Druid, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.$B$BDeliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.
940.title: Teldrassil

94003.completion: You have done what I could not and restored my family honor. For this, I will bestow a gift that few on Zephras are worthy to receive. I will teach out the secrets of the Skybreaker Defense.$B$BAlso, you will need a shield to put what I have to teach you into practice. Please, take this one. I have little use for it now that the Skybreaker Bulwark has been returned to me.$B$BBanu'Adoraah, friend.
94003.objectives: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
94003.text:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94004.completion: You brought da elixir!!$B$BT'anks, $R. You come all this way to help Sos'mol. No ogre ever done that before.$B$BSos'mol will remember this. Pay you back someday. Me promise.
94004.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94004.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94004.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength

94006.completion: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.
94006.objectives: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
94006.text:
Greetings, $N. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

94007.completion: I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin.
94007.objectives: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94007.text:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
94007.title: Taming the Beast

94013.completion: Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.$B$BGo with this knowledge and thrive. Be the $C that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
94013.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94013.progress: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $C.
94013.text:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.
94013.title: Taming the Beast

94050.completion: A fledgling $C, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.$B$BRemember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94050.objectives: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
94050.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $C.
94050.title: Training the Beast

94212.completion: I will admit, I expected the treacherous winds of the highlands to tear that letter to shreds. I had not imagined that someone would see my humble request, let alone deliver it straight to me.$B$BYour efforts are kind and admirable, $R. I will use this to aid my meditation.$B$BFeel free to stay and share a tale or two of your travels. I enjoy the company.
94212.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94212.progress: Come, warm yourself by the fire.
94212.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Elixir of Wisdom, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94212.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Wisdom

94213.completion: Ah, is this the potion I requested?$B$B<The elven woman respectfully takes the vial from you.>$B$BYour arrival is timely, and generosity deeply appreciated. I accept this, and offer you a small token of my gratitude.$B$BThank you, may we meet again.
94213.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94213.progress: Good day, $R. I appreciate the company but my attention is elsewhere. If we do not have business, please be on your way.
94213.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Lesser Mana Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94213.title: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Mana Potion

94214.completion: Then again, when you're fulfilling a rush order like this one, I can't blame you for wanting to capitalize on your gains.$B$BHere you go, pal. Thanks for hooking a goblin up with some much-needed shadow protection potions. Have you SEEN the stuff that goes on out here?
94214.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94214.progress: Heyo, for future reference, you shouldn't come charging at full-speed toward a goblin with a bodyguard! You never know what might happen.
94214.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Shadow Protection Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94214.title: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Protection Potion

94215.completion: <You waste little time offering the wiggling mass the Free Action Potion that was requested. It seems either unaware of your presence, or unable to claim the item.$B$BA handful of coins are scattered just beside the cocoon. You may decide to leave the potion there, and take the coins for yourself. Nature will surely sort itself out, in that case.>
94215.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94215.progress: <You approach a thrashing creature clearly trapped in spider silk, exactly where the writ marked on the map.>
94215.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Free Action Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94215.title: Craftsman's Writ: Free Action Potion
