94216.completion: <Ziz continues to talk in a hushed tone.>$B$BI'm not about to give you the whole spiel about how I got into this position, but here's some advice for you.$B$BSometimes, all you gotta do to impress your new boss is take credit for someone else's work. So you're going to hand over the elixir, and I am gonna talk about how much blood, sweat, and tears I poured into making it.$B$BIt's a new gig, okay? I need to make a good first impression!
94216.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94216.progress: Are you here about...$B$B<Ziz looks around his tiny hut suspiciously, and lowers his voice.>$B$BThe elixir?
94216.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Elixir of Lesser Agility, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94216.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Lesser Agility

94217.completion: Exactly what Short John Mithril ordered!$B$BHere's ye' coin. I'd keep it clutched to your chest as ye' scuttle out of here, the arena combatants thirst for riches as much as they thirst for blood!
94217.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94217.progress: Yarr, you be bringin' me my elixir?
94217.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94217.title: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

94218.completion: Oh, oh!! The elixir!$B$BMy, oh my. I am so sorry to have lashed out at you like that. I've been on edge ever since I was told that one of those goblins has supposedly put out a hit on me!$B$BSadly I cannot afford additional security, so the best I can do is chug one of these and hope for the best. Cheers!
94218.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94218.progress: If YOU are the assassin that the crewmen keep warning me about, well you had better think twice before charging at ME, buster!
94218.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Elixir of Defense, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94218.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Defense

94219.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94219.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Draught of Water Breathing, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94219.title: Craftsman's Writ: Draught of Water Breathing

94220.completion: Oh, you are delivering my dagger? Hah, I suppose my threat rang quite hollow then, hm?$B$BI must stay on high alert given my duties here, and especially with oth-- ahem, the foul Syndicate roaming about elsewhere here.$B$BWould you be so kind as to part with the blade, now? I must get back to my task.
94220.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94220.progress: It is unwise to sneak up on me, $R. Speak quickly, and speak quietly.
94220.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Pearl-Handled Dagger, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94220.title: Craftsman's Writ: Pearl-Handled Dagger

94221.completion: Ah, the Golden Rod I requested. I never expected it to arrive. I was considering going back to Ironforge to purchase one off the auction house. You saved me a trip, something these old feet greatly thank you for.$B$BI do not yet know how I can use this to commune with the Binding Stones, let alone if I even can, but I suspect this brings me one step closer.$B$BIn the worst case, well, I am happy to have a new cane.
94221.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94221.progress: <The dwarf seems to be in a deep state of meditation, though your approach interrupted his focus. Fortunately, a smile greets you.>
94221.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Golden Rod, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94221.title: Craftsman's Writ: Golden Rod

94222.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94222.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Iridescent Hammer, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94222.title: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer

94223.completion: <With the undead hordes endlessly gathering nearby and no sign of others, you choose to make use of your Silver Skeleton Key to effortlessly open the chest.$B$BDespite the claims of impressive riches, the trunk is nearly empty. At the very least there is enough present to cover some of the cost of this ordeal.>
94223.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94223.progress: <After following the instructions on the writ, you find yourself deep in a crypt surrounded by undead. There is a note on a nearby trunk.>$B$BWhomever first reads this will be the first to learn of my death. I am a mere caretaker of the Raven Hill Cemetery, whose presence is largely forgotten by even his employers at Darkshire. I have no heir with which to bestow my vast wealth unto. I have since stashed them away, in this box, for who or whatever manages to open it.
94223.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Silver Skeleton Key, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94223.title: Craftsman's Writ: Silver Skeleton Key

94224.completion: Whoa. You came well prepared! Hope that mace is for me, unless you plan to do ALL of the fighting.
94224.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94224.progress: Shh. Keep your voice down. I'm not ready for a fight, yet.
94224.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Heavy Bronze Mace, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94224.title: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Bronze Mace

94225.completion: These are the leggings I ordered, huh? "Three to five business days," they said. More like three to five business MONTHS!$B$BI submitted this when I was working for the Venture Co out there, and let me just say, that partnership is well over with, so we can consider this order expired.$B$BWhy aren't you leaving yet? Ugh, fine! Here's your payment.
94225.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94225.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Rough Bronze Leggings, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94225.title: Craftsman's Writ: Rough Bronze Leggings

94226.completion: Mmph. Seems to have been a severe mistranslation. I did not ask for green iron gauntlets, I specifically requested green iron knuckles.$B$B<MacKinley fakes an uppercut in your direction, stopping himself a small but calculated distance from cracking your jaw.>$B$BThese'll knock someone out cold anyway, I suppose I can use these while I wait for a replacement.$B$BHere's your payment. Oh, you expected more? Well, so did I.
94226.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94226.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Green Iron Gauntlets, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94226.title: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Gauntlets

94227.completion: Cluck? CLUCK CLUCK! BWOK!$B$B<The chicken glares menacingly toward Magus Tirth from afar, newly acquired blade in beak.>
94227.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94227.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Big Bronze Knife, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94227.title: Craftsman's Writ: Big Bronze Knife

94228.completion: At last! I've been stomping around the wetlands with soggy feet for days!$B$BHopefully these aren't prone to rusting either. I trust you know what you're doing.
94228.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94228.progress: Please tell me you're the one with the boots...
94228.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Green Iron Boots, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94228.title: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Boots

94229.completion: Oh. Oh! You're the engineer? I suppose at the very least you are the delivery boy in any case.$B$BPlease hand over the spyglass. I have little time and many things to inspect.
94229.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94229.progress: Whoa! I almost didn't see you there. I might have seen you coming sooner if a damned engineer would at last deliver my order.
94229.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Ornate Spyglass, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

943.text: Prospector Whelgar now holds the original fossil at his site in the Wetlands. When I discovered the Stone of Relu, I believed it to be the key to unlocking the mystery of the fossil.$B$BWhile I traveled on the road to meet Whelgar, I was attacked by raptors and the relic was lost. I don't know which one of the mottled beasts swallowed the relic but if you can retrieve it, I can unleash the power of these artifacts.$B$BBring me both the Stone of Relu, and the original fossil he holds.

94360.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94360.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Soul Pouch, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94360.title: Craftsman's Writ: Soul Pouch

94369.completion: <Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>$B$BI need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.$B$BThere is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.
94369.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
94369.text:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94369.title: The Fate of Zephras

94373.completion: Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. Strength, stamina, patience. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares.$B$BI'll craft ye a sapta now - accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
94373.objectives: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94373.progress: Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys - slow and stubborn, like a true $R. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.$B$BOthers may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
94373.text:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373.title: Call of Earth

94374.completion: Ah... $N... the earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.$B$BTo pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still - they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.
94374.objectives: Find the Spirit Stone and drink the Earth Sapta.
94374.text:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few shaman know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374.title: Call of Earth

94375.completion: Well done! Know this - totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.
94375.objectives: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94375.progress: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
94375.text:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375.title: Call of Earth

94411.completion: Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.$B$BThe mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.
94411.objectives: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
94411.text:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
94411.title: Meddlesome Mages

94413.completion: Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change.$B$BIf they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.
94413.objectives: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
94413.text:
The recent emergence of the ley lines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the ley line in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
94413.title: A Magical Affront

94414.completion: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.
94414.objectives: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
94414.progress: My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.$B$BAppreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.
94414.text:
Greetings, young $N. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94427.completion: You... you are a $C? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!
94427.objectives: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
94427.text:
A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
94427.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94434.completion: This is very kind of you, $C. Very kind indeed.
94434.objectives: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
94434.progress: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly $C.
94434.text:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance. 

It's my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
94434.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94435.completion: You have done well, $N. It was a small thing, but even small acts of service such as this may help strengthen our connection to the light.$B$BThe Dark Lady and many in her service mistrust us. Some even conspire against us, but we will visit their skepticism and fear with courage and righteousness. We will show them that we are members of the Forsaken and we are willing to do our part, be it large or small, to help our people prosper once again.$B$BTake this symbol, you will need it for what comes next.
94435.objectives: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
94435.text: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, $C.
94435.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436.completion: So you'll help me, then? Good, good. I'll admit I'm not proud of resorting to... well, resorting to asking paladins for aid. The priests waved me away and you might be my friend's only chance.$B$BPlease, help me.
94436.objectives:
Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94436.text:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
94436.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438.completion: I'm... back? And saved by a $C no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.$B$BIf you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more than you can do to help the Forsaken.
94438.objectives:
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. 

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94438.text:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440.completion: Thank you for saving my friend,$N. I will take these plans back to my commander and we will give those crusaders a welcoming they won't forget.$B$BI know that many among our people mistrust you paladins, but its clear to me that you are Forsaken through and through. I won't forget this, and I'll make sure others know of what you did here today.
94440.objectives: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
94440.text:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441.completion: The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by a $C who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely.$B$BYou have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the paladins of Tyr's Watch. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, $N.
94441.objectives: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Bandarion Keep.
94441.text:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us. 

You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, $N.
94441.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94449.completion: Hmm... that elder sent ye, eh? Well, a $C's word is solid, so I'll not argue. That means ye're ready for the next sapta. The sapta of fire. I see it in yer eyes already -- the burnin', the hunger. Ye've tasted power, and now ye want more. But mind yerself, $N. Remember what the stone taught ye. Fire's easy to wield, but harder to master. Know when to hold back.
94449.objectives: Find Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94449.text:
It's been long since ye were last tested, $N. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye. 

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
94449.title: Call of Fire

94465.completion: Ah, me apologies, $N. Didn't spot the Torch in yer hand. An honor to meet ye proper.$B$BMany a wanderer climbs these heights chasin' tales of treasure or beasts, only to find naught but stone and silence. But we know better, don't we, $N?$B$BThis shrine holds truths far deeper than the Alliance can fathom. To us, it's a sacred flame that waits to be awakened.
94465.objectives: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94465.progress: Greetin's, $N. Ye've made it to the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame, eh? Not many do. Only those well-versed in the $C's path can grasp the secrets this place holds.$B$BShame ye came all this way just to be turned back--the climb's no stroll through Dun Morogh. But I'm the shrine's keeper, and I won't be lettin' just any foot trod about.
94465.text:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465.title: Call of Fire

94466.completion: These'll do fine, $N.$B$BFire ain't just fury and ruin--mark me words. It's life, it's forge, it's the breath o' creation. All things are bound in balance. One force tempers the other, gives it meaning. Without shadow, light's but a glare. Without flame, stone's but cold memory.$B$BMasterin' magic means knowin' when to blend, not just burn. That's true wisdom, lad.
94466.objectives: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94466.progress: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, $N--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.
94466.text:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, $N? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466.title: Call of Fire

94467.completion: A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.$B$BYou place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire. The smoke seems to drift towards the mountain of blackrock.
94467.objectives: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
94467.progress: The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch.$B$BBlackrock mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.
94467.text: The fire sapta's ready, $N. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.$B$BStrike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.
94467.title: Call of Fire

94468.completion: By Madoran's beard, yer spirit burns brighter than any torch I've laid eyes on, $N--and that's somethin' to be proud of.$B$BKeep walkin' this path, and the elements'll bend to yer will. Our kin will come to ye for wisdom and guidance. So let me be the first to offer me hearty congratulations -- and present ye with yer newest totem. Ye've earned it, flameborn.
94468.objectives: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94468.progress: Aye, $N? What do ye have there?
94468.text: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.$B$BYou start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468.title: Call of Fire

94472.completion: Take this and remember, it is sacred.
94472.objectives: Speak to Teo Hammerstorm for another Earth Sapta.
94472.title: Earth Sapta

94473.completion: May fire burn within your heart, Ukko.$B$BThe elements await you.
94473.objectives: Speak to Braldir Ashmantle for another Fire Sapta.
94473.title: Fire Sapta

94484.completion: Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?$B$B<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>$B$BSo the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.$B$BIt seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94484.objectives: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94484.text:
A moment if you will, $N. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484.title: Unnerving Silence

94485.completion: <Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>$B$BThank you, $N, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.
94485.progress: Have you found the Lady's Tear?
94485.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485.title: Tears of the Lady

94486.completion: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.
94486.objectives: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
94486.progress: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.
94486.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486.title: Feathers for Binding

94487.completion: <Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>$B$BSo many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, $C.$B$BI will hold onto them for safe keeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.
94487.objectives: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
94487.progress: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.
94487.text:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94488.completion: <Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>$B$BThank you, $N. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.$B$BDo not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.
94488.objectives: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
94488.progress: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?
94488.text:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488.title: The Ties That Bind

94489.completion: <Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>$B$BNo... no! This is far worse than I had--$B$B<Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.>$B$BThey will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
94489.objectives: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.
94489.progress: $C! You have returned. Were you able to reach my brothers and sisters? Did you find Jorel?
94489.text:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
94489.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94490.completion: They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?$B$B<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>$B$BThey murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.$B$BGo, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.
94490.objectives: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
94490.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
94490.title: Ripped Missive

94491.completion: <Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.>$B$BI--I'm sorry, $N. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.$B$BThis is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows sacrifice be in vain.
94491.objectives: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
94491.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $N. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491.title: The Fate of the Den

94493.completion: The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with little to no warning. Many inside my den lay wounded or dying. I had attempted to send a message to Valanaar but it appears my efforts were in vain.$B$BPlease, if you have come here I beg for your help. I don't know how much longer my fellows will be able to survive this onslaught.
94493.objectives: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94493.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straits indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94493.title: A Sacrifice in Vain

94494.completion: The wind's rushin' at yer back, the stone's firm beneath yer boots, and the fire in yer belly's burnin' bright. Aye, it's time ye learned the truth o' water's purity. Yer path's been long, but it's yer spirit that'll carry ye further still. Now, go on, take that first step. The mountain waits for no one.
94494.objectives: Find Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94494.text:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, $N. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, $N.
94494.title: Call of Water

94495.completion: Aye, I see it in yer eyes, $R. You're wonderin' what kind o' soul chooses to live out here, deep in the Wetlands, with Dark Iron scum lurkin' about and nary a guard in sight. Well, we all have our reasons, love.$B$BBut the real question is, what brings you to our home? Out here at the edge of the falls, I reckon we both know the answer to that.
94495.objectives: Find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94495.text:
If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.

Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.
94495.title: Call of Water

94497.completion: Glad ye managed to steer clear o' the Dark Iron. Shame they've crept so far north--makes ye wonder what dwarfkind could do if the clans ever stopped squabblin' and worked as one.$B$BStill, the tides rise high when the moons are strong, and the seawater floods the marsh. It's here that we study our estuary water.$B$BThank ye for this sacred offering, it marks the beginning of your stage as a vessel--one who seeks the waters' wisdom.
94497.objectives: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.
94497.progress: I'm nearly ready to send ye off on the rest o' yer tasks. But tell me, have ye filled the skin yet? The ocean brings life, aye -- but it carries sediment, minerals, and energies far different from the snowmelt and springwater of the highlands. Where sea and spring meet, there's wisdom to be found.
94497.text:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
94497.title: Call of Water

94499.completion: Aye, this is good water, $N. The magic used by the shadowseers in the region must be changin' the murlocs. Nothin' but pure water, this be. Yer dedication to the task at hand and abilities to seek out that which is needed proves you're ready for the next stage of your journey.$B$BOne more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Norric will be pleased as well.
94499.objectives: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94499.progress: The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it -- fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em.
94499.text:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499.title: Call of Water

94500.completion: Well done, $N! With all three samples in hand, I'll brew ye a vial o' water so pure it'd make the mountains weep. It's the final piece for yer rite o' passage. I'm proud to call ye kin, $N. Ye've done $C proud, and I look forward to hearing yer tales in the future.
94500.objectives: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94500.progress: Do you have the water yet, $N? If ye haven't made the trek to Kalimdor yet, be careful.
94500.text:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
94500.title: Call of Water

94501.completion: Ahh, water blessed by Hervdana herself, and gathered by your own hands? A gift indeed.$B$BThese vials shall birth your sapta, letting you glimpse the water spirits at Stendel's Pond, near Moonbrook. The last few drops of the water have an equally important purpose... waste not even a cork stopper dampened with sacred water.
94501.objectives: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94501.progress: Hello again, $N. Yer looking well.$B$BWhat brings you back to me so soon?
94501.text: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.
94501.title: Call of Water

94502.completion: You place the bracers atop the shrine and then pour the remaining drops of Norric's potion into dry stone. You begin to incant the simple words Norric taught you and the droplets vaporize atop the stone within the bindings....
94502.objectives:
Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.
Return to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.
94502.progress: The shrine stands aged and forgotten, cloaked in dust and cobwebs. The pond beside it lies eerily still, its surface untouched by wind or life. Scattered along the shore are the bones of beasts once burdened by labor. The water's murky sheen raises a troubling question--has it been poisoned by the surrounding malaise, or is it the very source of it?
94502.text:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must drink the water sapta, then face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502.title: Call of Water

94503.completion: Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.$B$BCorruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.
94503.objectives: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.
94503.text: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
94503.title: Call of Water

94505.completion: Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, $N. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye.$B$BYer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.
94505.objectives: Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94505.progress: How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.
94505.text: Take shard. Take shard and give life.$B$BGive life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.$B$BYou protect and give life with water's power.
94505.title: Call of Water

94559.objectives: Seek out the Al'Aketh Turncoat in the Shen'dar Highlands.
94559.text:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a house just northwest of Valanaar, just inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, find out and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.
94559.title: UNUSED

94568.completion: We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.$B$BWe are going to need a different approach.
94568.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
94568.progress: That turncoat risked everything to escape the cult and bring us this crystal...
94568.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568.title: The Cult's True Plans

94638.completion: The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.$B$BYou have done well, $C. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.$B$BGo now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.
94638.objectives: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
94638.progress: What I ask of you is no easy task. Take heart in your courage and return to me when the deed is done.
94638.text:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
94638.title: Strength and Mercy

94774.completion: I'm glad you've arrived, $N. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.$B$BThere are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.
94774.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94774.text: You've caught the attention of our superiors, $N. They've asked you to travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94774.title: Divine Grace

94775.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94775.text: Elune bless you, good $R. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.$B$BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94775.title: Divine Grace

94776.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94776.text: Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, $N. High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light wants to speak to you. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.$B$BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94776.title: Divine Grace

94777.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94777.text: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, $R. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Cathedral of Light. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.$B$BElune be with you, good $R.
94777.title: Divine Grace

94778.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94778.text: You're needed in Stormwind, $N. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, $N.
94778.title: Divine Grace

94779.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94779.text: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $N.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.
94779.title: Divine Grace

94789.completion: Aye, I shall give ye what's needed to focus wind spells and to call upon the spirits o' air. Take this totem, and when ye are ready, train with me some more.
94789.objectives: Find Veyric Thundervein in Arathi Highlands.
94789.text:
The winds o' Azeroth greet ye, and soon ye'll stand among some o' our mightiest kin. I'm proud to see how far ye've come--your future looks bright indeed.

The element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.

Make your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.
94789.title: Call of Air

94792.completion: Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner.
94792.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94792.progress: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $C.
94792.text:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.
94792.title: Taming the Beast

94793.completion: A fledgling $C, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.$B$BRemember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94793.objectives: Speak to Isaac Chan in Goldshire.
94793.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young $C.
94793.title: Training the Beast

94819.completion: Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great $C, $N. Maintain your vigilance and dedication!$B$BYou are ready for your next lesson in service.
94819.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94819.text: $N, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
94819.title: Contingency Plan

94820.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94820.text: Your race is so very clever, $N. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to reclaiming your city, but with the burden of keeping your families safe in exile. That yearning for home must weigh heavily on you.$B$BWord came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priestess Mims in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep her waiting. May Elune guide your travels.
94820.title: Contingency Plan

94821.completion: You took your time arriving, $N. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.
94821.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94821.text: A priest recently visited our halls seeking you out, young $R. He said that he was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out High Priestess Mims--she will tell you more.$B$BThe Light be with you, $N.
94821.title: Confounding Flash

94822.completion: You took your time arriving, Cub. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.
94822.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94822.text: You've caught the attention of our superiors, $N. They've asked you to travel to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Mims. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94822.title: Confounding Flash

94823.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94823.text: Elune bless you, good $R. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.$B$BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Hall of Mysteries as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Mims. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94823.title: Confounding Flash

94824.completion: You took your time arriving, Papi. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.
94824.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94824.text: Time's come for you to head to Ironforge, $N. High Priestess Mims in the Hall of Mysteries commands you to come speak with her. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.$B$BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94824.title: Confounding Flash

94825.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94825.text: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, $R. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Hall of Mysteries. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.$B$BElune be with you, good $R.
94825.title: Confounding Flash

94826.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94826.text: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $N.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out your High Priestess for further training.
94826.title: Confounding Flash

94863.completion: Well done, $N! You're quite in tune with the beast.
94863.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94863.text:
You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a hunter once more.
94863.title: Taming the Beast

94864.completion: The brawn of the forest. Brave work, $N!
94864.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94864.progress: Go forth, $N, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.
94864.text:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion. 

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.
94864.title: Taming the Beast

94872.objectives: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
94872.text:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

94873.completion: <Molkar peeks into the bag. A smirk tugs at his lips, falling only briefly as he catches a glimpse of a clearly fake totem. He pretends to not see it.>$B$BI do not know what possessed an outsider to bring our clan such a gift. It is a great boon for our people, as the Magram Clan have been unusually vicious as of late.$B$BYou no longer need to tread carefully in our village. I will inform Uthek, who will speak with the Khan.
94873.objectives: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
94873.progress: An outsider this deep in the village? You best be bringing business.
94873.text:
Either dominant centaur clan is likely to pose a good ally, but I ought to offer a word of caution regarding the Gelkis.

I have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.

I have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.
94873.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis

94896.completion: Thank you, $C, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
94896.objectives: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
94896.progress: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.
94896.text:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896.title: Aid For The Refugees

94897.completion: <Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>$B$BOh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.$B$BThank you, $C. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
94897.objectives: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
94897.progress: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, $C, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.
94897.text:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94898.text:
When our home started to fall into the sky that fateful night, it's as if the elements themselves were waiting to consume us. Wind spirits began appearing as we were fleeing, and to our dismay they began attacking the fleeing survivors.

We lost many villagers to the sky, but even more to the relentless anger of those wind spirits. I don't know if it was our village falling into the sky, but they are extremely dangerous.

If you are able, please put them to rest.
94898.title: Violent Winds (Temp Disabled)

94911.completion: A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease?$B$BWell, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
94911.objectives: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
94911.text:
Greetings, young $R. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911.title: Child of Nature

94912.completion: Greetings, fellow $C. It pleases me to meet a fellow $C from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.$B$BI think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
94912.objectives: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.
94912.text:
Greetings, young $C. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912.title: Child of Nature

94913.completion: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $C.
94913.objectives: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
94913.text: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.$B$BAs for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94913.title: Moonglade

94914.completion: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $C.
94914.objectives: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
94914.text: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.$B$BAs for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94914.title: Moonglade

94946.completion: Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.$B$BAs idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.
94946.objectives: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
94946.text:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
94946.title: The Magical City of Dalaran

94947.completion: Well met, $C. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.$B$BA Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect an emissary from the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.$B$BOn behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.
94947.objectives: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
94947.text:
It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.
94947.title: Welcome to Azeroth

94978.completion: Well tamed, $N! You are becoming adept already.
94978.objectives:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94978.progress: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $C.
94978.text:
Every hunter begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
94978.title: Taming the Beast

94979.objectives:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94979.progress: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $C.
94979.text:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979.title: Taming the Beast

95034.completion: So now you understand. At the very end of his strength after being pierced by a dozen gnoll blades, he reared up to strike me. In that final moment we locked eyes, and I could tell he still knew who he was and that he recognized me. He knew what was happening but he had no control over himself. That was the worst part.$B$BIf such a thing is possible, I will see the creature that doomed him dead so that it can never visit this horror on another living thing. I swear it upon the sky above.
95034.objectives: Speak with Lumina Windsinger in the Sepulcher.
95034.progress: I've never seen anything like what happened to Banon. Azeroth is a wonderful place, but the sheer breadth of what is possible here is truly terrifying.
95034.text:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034.title: The Debt

95036.completion: Now that we've got the materials we need, we just need a smith to craft the blade for us. I think I know just such a smith.
95036.objectives: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.progress: Trust in the light to guide your blade. However, the light needs a good blade to guide.
95036.text:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95041.completion: These cards seem a bit damp... but I can work with this! Thank you, $N!
95041.objectives: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.
95041.progress: How is the data retrieval progressing?
95041.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041.title: Data Hoarders

95042.completion: You'll no doubt notice the corruption that permeates this gem. For your purposes, The magic needed to dispel the evil that the naga witches have infused into the gem is rather simple. A shame really, there's much one could learn from such powers.$B$BI don't suppose you'd be willing to abandon whatever quest caused you seek this gem, and sell it to me instead? It could prove valuable to my... academic pursuits.
95042.objectives: Bring a Kor Gem to Ulric Frostveil in Ashenvale.
95042.progress: Kor gems can be used for great acts of evil. Far be it from me to judge if your intentions are pure. It matters not to me.
95042.text:
A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing. 

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the Alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, $C.
95042.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

95065.completion: Great timing! Caught a big one with my last bait. Great day so far. They're really biting out here!$B$BTell you what, since you were kind enough to keep this old man in business how about a few fish for the road?
95065.objectives: Bring 1 Shiny Bauble and 3 Nightcrawlers to Gilbert Gray at the harbor in Stormwind.
95065.progress: Did you get the fishing supplies?
95065.text:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065.title: Fishin' Time

95111.completion: Interesting. I don't think anyone has ever asked me to actually carry out a custom commission for them. Mostly I just make humble, functional weapons in my own style. It's not much, but its honest work and I don't seek accolades or glory.$B$BI'm happy to try, but why would you seek me for this? There are plenty of smiths in the Undercity that will take on custom jobs like this.
95111.objectives: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.
95111.progress: Are you in need of a blade, $C?
95111.text:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111.title: An Underrated Talent

95125.completion: This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity.$B$BAka'Magosh, friend.
95125.objectives: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
95125.progress: My blade will not fail you, $C.
95125.text:
These are some truly fine materials, $C. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.title: Ott's Masterwork

95126.completion: <Trevan takes the blade and inspects it carefully.>$B$BThis will do nicely, $N. I knew that Ott had it in him to make something truly great.$B$BThe only thing left now is to kill that beast. Speak with Lumina when you are ready.
95126.objectives: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.
95126.progress: Was Ott able to carry out the commission?
95126.text: Here's the blade. You said that a paladin named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.
95126.title: The Moonsilver Blade

95140.completion: Thank you, $N.
