Banon may now rest in peace.$B$BIf you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people.$B$B$B$BIt is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, $C.
95140.objectives: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.
95140.progress: Is it done? Is the beast slain?
95140.text:
I see that you have your weapon now, $C. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.title: Old Fire-Eye

95161.completion: Oh no...$B$BIt's nice of you to bring this, but I don't think Jeremy is ready to see it. Matron Nightingale said my little Jeremy hasn't spoken since the attack on Lordaeron, and I don't intend to force him now. Showing him this will only cause him more pain.$B$BDon't look at me like that. I won't hide his past from him, but he needs time to heal. I'll give this to him when he's older. Thank you for stopping by, but I think it's time you should go.
95161.objectives: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
95161.text:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161.title: Remember That I Love You

95189.completion: How in the world did you find this? It's in such remarkable condition... all things considered.$B$BThank you for restoring this piece of Alliance history, $C. I'll have my best people get to work restoring this immediately.
95189.objectives: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.progress: Welcome to the gallery. Feel free to browse.
95189.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95195.completion: Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves.$B$BYour duty to Stormwind is commended, $N. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.
95195.objectives: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
95195.progress: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, $N. What is it?
95195.text: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195.title: Bloodied Insignia

952.completion: Ah. Thank you, $N. It is strange, though. The Arch Druid always seems in such a hurry. The forest knows that all shall come to pass in the appointed time. Shan'do Stormrage understood that.
952.objectives: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, south of Auberdine.
952.progress: Ah. $C. How may Onu assist you?
952.text: If you had enough time to run messages for the Oracle Tree, then I'm sure that I can press you into service to deliver a message to the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, due south of Auberdine.$B$BYou will most likely have to secure transport on a hippogryph, but I have faith enough in you that you can manage that. Take this to Onu, the Ancient of Lore. He has been awaiting word from me, even as I waited for news from the Oracle Glade.
952.title: Grove of the Ancients

95204.completion: <Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>$B$BWell I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.$B$BThank you for your aid in restoring our history, $C. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
95204.objectives: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
95204.progress: What have you got there, $C? A tasty morsel?
95204.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95212.completion: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, $C!
95212.objectives: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
95212.progress: You look chilly, $C. How goes the hunt?
95212.text:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95213.completion: <The $R turns pale as he sees the empty keg.>$B$B...Where did you find this?
95213.objectives: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten at Gol'Bolar Quarry.
95213.text:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95214.completion: That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, $C.$B$BPlease accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.
95214.objectives: Recover 16 Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.
95214.progress: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214.text: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
95214.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95216.completion: You killed it??$B$BHmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.$B$BGet out of my sight!
95216.objectives: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
95216.progress: Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.$B$BI must see this strain for myself!
95216.text:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.title: The New Plague

95217.completion: You're a resourceful one, $N.$B$BNow listen up - I'm not going to repeat myself!
95217.objectives: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.
95217.progress: Don't slack off, $N. Smithin' isn't for the lazy!
95217.text:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
95217.title: The Quarry's Smith

95250.objectives: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
95250.text:
What do you want, $R? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250.title: Abominable Creatures

95314.completion: You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse...$B$B...but enough of superstition and rumors, $N. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.
95314.objectives: Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
95314.progress: I trust you did not get lost?
95314.text:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95328.completion: What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.$B$BI welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, $C. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.
95328.objectives: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
95328.progress: Do you have something for me, $C?
95328.text: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95349.completion: More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.$B$BAzeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.
95349.objectives: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.
95349.text:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, $N.
95349.title: The Earthen Ring

95350.completion: Lok-tar, $C. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.$B$BAn Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect members of the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.$B$BYou have my blessing to travel through horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.
95350.objectives: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.
95350.text:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, $N.
95350.title: Welcome to Azeroth

95384.objectives: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.
95384.text: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>
95384.title: Partial Mystical Notes

95494.completion: Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade.$B$BI've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.
95494.objectives: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
95494.text:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95495.completion: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
95495.objectives: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
95495.progress: Greetings, $C. What brings you up to my property today?
95495.text:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495.title: The Hermit Tanner

95507.completion: Thank you for your aid, $C. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.
95507.objectives: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.
95507.progress: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507.text:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
95507.title: Vrang's Game

95508.completion: Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.$B$BPlease, take this. It's not much, but its the least I can do.$B$BSafe travels, $C.
95508.objectives: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
95508.text:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508.title: Unwelcome Guests

95534.completion: So there was a fire elemental living in the old bellows up in Strahnbrad? The real mystery is how it got there, I suppose. Either way, good work. Your efforts will be rewarded.
95534.objectives: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.
95534.text:
<The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>

Rumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.

There's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.

< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >
95534.title: Strahnbrad Mystery

95621.completion: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.
95621.objectives: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
95621.progress: The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.$B$BI don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621.text:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
95621.title: Trouble in the Valley

95646.completion: It is worse than I feared. An ancient energy stirs. It would be most wise for you to carry word to your eager excavators to stop digging, for their own safety.
95646.objectives: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
95646.progress: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646.text:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647.objectives: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
95647.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95663.completion: These are the courageous few? Mind your voices.
95663.objectives: Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
95663.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664.completion: It is a favored sign to have a stranger approach in this manner. I feel a power amidst you... what is this you have brought?
95664.objectives: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
95664.progress: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664.text: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664.title: Elder Knowledge

95682.completion: Don't mind me snatching that right out of your hands.$B$BI recognized that orcish scrawl. So they're hoping to appease Rend? A fruitless and wasted effort.$B$BNo matter, this is highly valuable knowledge for the dark lady to consider.$B$BHere, I won't be taking any of this with me--and don't talk about the mission, grunt.
95682.objectives: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
95682.progress: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682.text:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682.title: Open the Maw

95697.completion: Look at the marbling on these! What are they eating up there? Thank you for going all the way and back for us. If you don't mind waiting, we'll cook some for you now, on the house, of course!
95697.objectives: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
95697.progress: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697.title: Changing Tastes

95737.completion: Llana must be wondering where those grass seeds are that I promised I'd have my husband bring back! It comforts me to know she's as concerned as I am. It must be something about the excavation site itself that we're both sensing.
95737.objectives: Speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.text:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.title: Seeking Caitlin

95748.objectives: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.
95748.text:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

$N, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.
95748.title: The Gurubashi Legends of Old

95770.objectives: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.
95770.text:
After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.

In my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.

I have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.

Go and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.
95770.title: Locating the Lost City

95772.objectives: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
95772.text:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772.title: Songblade Search

95773.objectives: Gather 10 Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.
95773.text:
$C, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.
95773.title: Enemies in the Water

95774.completion: I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge!$B$BYou have done me... done us... a great favor, $N.
95774.objectives: Slay quilboars and collect 4 of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
95774.progress: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774.text:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95775.objectives: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95775.text:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $C, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
95775.title: The Drowned City

95776.objectives: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.
95776.text:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
95776.title: The Only Good Brinescale...

95786.objectives: Find Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore and bring him the Savage Coast Report Bundle.
95786.text:
$N, I have a friend in the Hillsbrad Foothills that is studying troll legends and evil magic. I think he may have insight about how this foul magic captured Colenel Kurzen's mind.

I also have a scout's report that the local trolls seem to be agitated, mentioning the word..."I'lalai".

I must know if this is related to Kurzen's corruption! Here, take the fetishes and legends along with this scouting report to Loremaster Dibbs. With any luck he will be able to unravel some of their secrets.
95786.title: An Acquaintance in Southshore

95787.objectives: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95787.text:
<Loremaster Dibbs' hands shake as he reads the scouting report and the troll legends.>

Could it be? By this account it sounds like the lost troll city of I'lalai has risen just off the coast of Stranglethorn! We must investigate immediately. Why, if my research is correct this could be the archeological discovery of the century!

Please, I know it is a long trek back to Stranglethorn but if you find yourself in this Drowned City, collect any legends you find there and return them to me.
95787.title: Take Two With Water

95788.objectives: Collect 5 I'lalai Fetishes from trolls in the Drowned City.
95788.text:
The Skullsplitter fetishes Brother Nimetz sent with you are indeed powerful, though I do not think they contributed to Kurzen's condition, or at least not directly.

Still, if the rumors are true and the lost troll city of I'lalai has indeed risen from its watery grave, it is possible the dark magics used to raise the doomed city may be related.

If you dare to venture into the Drowned City of I'lalai, please gather any troll fetishes you find and bring them here to me for further study.
95788.title: Magics of the Drowned City

95795.completion: Ah no...$B<He buries his head in his hands and sobs.>$B$BI should 'ave gone with 'em.$B$BMuch of what I was smithin' was for 'im, was plannin' a surprise but it wasn't ready when he came by gettin' things for his journey.$B$BNow that these are finished, I don't have it in me to reforge or sell any of it.$BYou can have this. It's the least I can do for you, bringing me this grim day.
95795.text:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795.title: Fallen in the Fen

95803.completion: I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.$B$BThere may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.$B$BWe will be watching.
95803.objectives: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
95803.text:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803.title: A Token of Good Faith

95805.completion: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
95805.objectives: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!
95805.progress: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805.text:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!
95805.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95809.completion: Goodness, that sounds terrible!$B$BBy the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.$B$B<She holds the reed-woven heart to her own.>$B$BI'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.
95809.objectives: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95809.progress: I'm more than worried about him!
95809.text:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809.title: Heartwoven

95810.completion: Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there.$B$BWell, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.
95810.objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands excavation site.
95810.text:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810.title: Lost Relic Carry

95816.objectives: Bring the completed form to Elaine Compton in Redridge Mountains.
95816.text:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95816.title: Sign Me Up!

95817.objectives: Meet Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.
95817.text:
Have you ever met Rotgath Stonebeard? He is a dwarven blacksmith in Ironforge. Not the most chatty fellow around, but always reliable. We often come to him when we need bulk crafts of simpler designs--the kind that Stondry is too proud to take on himself.

His turnaround times are excellent, particularly when it comes to helping new craftspeople get their shops established. I would trust no other to get your sign made fast. Let him know I sent you if he gives you any trouble!
95817.title: Rotgath Stonebeard

95818.objectives: Bring the requested materials to Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.
95818.text:
We can get ye sorted out and out of here in no time, provided you have the materials on hand! We are going to need 25 Mithril Bars and 15 Heavy Leather. Normally we need some other metals and the like too, but I've got some scrap that's been taking up space we can use for those extra bits.

Oh, as a personal favor, I am gonnae ask for 5 Goldthorn as well. My wife knows a great recipe for tea and I'd like to surprise her. Consider this your payment!
95818.title: A Quick Craft

95819.objectives: Bring the completed form to Jornah in The Barrens.
95819.text:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95819.title: Sign Me Up!

95883.completion: <The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.$B$BIt appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>
95883.objectives: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95883.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.title: The Tortured Soul

95884.completion: <Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone.$B$BThis is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.>
95884.objectives: Find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95884.text:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884.title: The Offering Stone

95885.completion: <The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.$B$BThe rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.$B$BSomething glitters from within the remnants...>
95885.objectives: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.
95885.text:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885.title: The Offering of Blood

95981.completion: Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.$B$BFor now, however, the why is irrelevant.
95981.objectives: Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards and 8 Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
95981.text:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981.title: Watching the Roads

95998.completion: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
95998.objectives: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
95998.progress: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
95998.text:
Well howdy there, $C. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998.title: The Great Outdoors

95999.completion: Excellent work, $N! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!
95999.objectives: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
95999.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96016.objectives: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
96016.text:
Ye did good, and I can see yer itchin' fer yer reward. Sorry tae say, I'm not exactly a dwarf of many possessions.

<Veyric gestures broadly at his remote location.>

Tell ye what, though. I hear a troll named the Windwatcher lives out in the Alterac Mountains. He's a powerful shaman himself, and an expert in storm elementals. If ye bring that there elemental core to him, I bet he can make ye a weapon worthy of yer victory.
96016.title: The Tempest's Weapons

96031.completion: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96031.objectives: Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96031.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $C. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

96044.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96044.objectives: Speak with Tognus Flintfire in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96044.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
96044.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

96045.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96045.objectives: Speak with Vosur Brakthel in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96045.text: Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
96045.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

96046.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96046.objectives: Speak with Yarr Hammerstone in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96046.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
96046.title: Camping 101: Mining

96047.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96047.objectives: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96047.progress: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.
96047.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $C.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
96047.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96050.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96050.objectives: Speak with Paxton Ganter near Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96050.progress: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.
96050.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
96050.title: Camping 101: Fishing

96055.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96055.objectives: Speak with Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96055.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

96056.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96056.objectives: Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96056.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96057.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96057.objectives: Speak with Uthrar Threx in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96057.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96057.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96058.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96058.objectives: Speak with Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96058.text:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
96058.title: Camping 101: Engineering

96059.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96059.objectives: Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96059.text:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96101.completion: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96101.objectives: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96101.progress: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96101.text:
Greetings, $C. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101.title: The Great Outdoors

96102.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96102.objectives: Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96102.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96130.completion: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
96130.objectives: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.
96130.progress: Have you found the big wolf?
96130.text:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130.title: Chakuyak

96135.objectives: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
96135.text:
Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.

Go to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.
96135.title: Heed My Call

96136.objectives: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
96136.text:
As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.

I could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, $N?
96136.title: Call of Air

96137.completion: Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her.$B$BRest assured I will take great care of this dagger.
96137.objectives: Defeat 10 Young Black Ravagers and 7 Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96137.text:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
96137.title: Ira's Dagger

96138.completion: Merrick Valor, you say? Poor boy always wanted to prove himself. It was a shame what happened to him and his family.$B$BThank you for bringing this, $N. Perhaps it can shed some additional light on Raven Hill's history.
96138.objectives: Defeat 8 Splint Fist Warriors and 4 Splint Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96138.text:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138.title: Merrick's Bow

96139.completion: This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.$B$BI'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
96139.objectives: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
96139.progress: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139.title: The Valor Family

962.completion: Ah, splendid specimens. You have done well, $N.
962.objectives: Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff wants you to collect 10 Serpentbloom.
962.progress: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962.text: The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, $N. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.$B$BRecently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.$B$BUnfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
962.title: Serpentbloom

96204.completion: Thank you again, $N. I've been aquatinting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.$B$BI've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. As a sky-touched shen'dorei elf traveling through horde territory, I can certainly understand how easily intolerance and prejudice can take root.$B$BYou and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
96204.objectives: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.
96204.text:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $C.
96204.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96222.objectives: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.
96222.text:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
96222.title: Khan Hratha

96241.completion: Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.$B$BThank you for your aid, $C. It be much appreciated.
96241.objectives: Use the Toxin Extractor to gather 5 Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.
96241.progress: Did ya get what I need?
96241.text:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
96241.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96243.completion: The land itself let me know ye were comin'! Aye, sometimes, the burnin' fire within us is enough to power us through the snow without even touchin' the ground!
96243.objectives: Find Teo Hammerstorm in Dun Morogh.
96243.text:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243.title: Call of Earth

96259.completion: Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.
96259.objectives: Kill 10 Gloomrise Hatchlings and 5 Gloomrise Soldiers.
96259.text:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259.title: Defending the Dead

96260.completion: These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.$B$BHere, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.$B$BEarthmother watch over you, $C.
96260.objectives: Gather 3 strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.
96260.progress: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260.text:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260.title: Stronger than Steel

96261.completion: Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.$B$BThank you, $N. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.
96261.text:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
96261.title: The Broodmother

96264.completion: Interestin'. The quilboar plan tae flood the Thousand Needles, eh? Those good fer nothin' beasts never did respect the elements. With abuse of this magnitude, it's no wonder we can feel it from here.$B$BYe did good findin' the source of this threat, $N, but now we gotta put an end to it.
96264.objectives: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
96264.progress: Back so soon? What'd ye find?
96264.text:
So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing.

If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.

Earth's rumblin', $N. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.
96264.title: Elemental Aid

96294.completion: This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?$B$BI will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this. Perhaps they will know more.$B$BThank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.
96294.objectives: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.
96294.text:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
96294.title: A Darker Truth

96339.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

96390.completion: These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.$B$BHopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
96390.objectives: Slay 10 Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.
96390.text:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96391.completion: Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.$B$BThank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.
96391.objectives: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.
96391.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391.title: Underground Map

96392.completion: So ye see now, $C? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.$B$BYe look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
96392.objectives: Speak with Earthseer Farsen and ask him to lend you his farsight to observe the Dark Iron threat.
96392.progress: Farsight can show ye a great many things, even things ye'd rather not see.
96392.text:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392.title: Farsen's Watch

96393.completion: A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.$B$BThe guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.$B$BThank ye for yer service to Ironforge,$C. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.
96393.objectives: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
96393.text:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96394.completion: Ah good, its done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?
96394.objectives: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.progress: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.
96394.text:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.title: The Restless Dead

96395.objectives: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.
96395.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403.completion: Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned!$B$BNow, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
96403.objectives: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
96403.progress: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403.text:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403.title: Important Heirlooms

96408.objectives: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
96408.text:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
96408.title: A Visitor to Dun Morogh

96604.completion: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96604.objectives: Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96604.progress: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96604.text:
Lok-tar, $C. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604.title: The Great Outdoors

96626.completion: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.$B$BRaise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.$B$BYou can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96626.objectives: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.
96626.progress: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96626.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $C. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627.completion: I appreciate the lookin' out, $C. That marshal's just a worrywart.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96627.objectives: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
96627.text:
$N, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627.title: The Adventurer

96628.completion: You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $C.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96628.objectives: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.
96628.progress: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628.title: The Adventurer

96629.completion: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.$B$BRaise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.$B$BYou can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

96630.completion: Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $C.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96630.objectives: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
96630.progress: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96630.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630.title: The Adventurer

96634.completion: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.$B$BRaise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.$B$BYou can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96634.objectives: Speak with Zarrin in Dolanaar to learn to become a cook.
96634.progress: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96634.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $C. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96634.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96638.objectives: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
96638.text:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638.title: The Adventurer

96656.objectives: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.
96656.text:
$N, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656.title: The Adventurer

96659.completion: Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, $C.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96659.objectives: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
96659.progress: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
96659.title: The Adventurer

What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.$B$BRaise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.$B$BYou can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
