96774.objectives: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
96774.text:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

96779.completion: With Tomas dead, Durnholde Keep will no doubt be destabilized. Lowly thugs of the Syndicate's kind often fall to disarray without a figurehead to lead them.$B$BGood work, $N. I may call upon you for future missions.
96779.objectives: Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.
96779.text:
Sometimes, $R, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.
96779.title: Syndicate Sabotage

96781.objectives: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.
96781.text:
We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.

They're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.

I ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.

If you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.
96781.title: What's the Big Idea?

96782.objectives: Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.
96782.text:
It seems our friend Barton here has made this very easy for us. He is after two heirlooms of the Perenolde family within the ruins of Alterac. The Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield.

From the report, it seems these armaments are within two towers among the ruins. Best we acquire them before the Syndicate does.

The ogres occupying the ruins are fierce, but I trust you should be able to sneak past them without needing to bloody your blade at all.
96782.title: Covert Extraction

96783.completion: <Taking the uniform, you ready yourself for the next part of your mission.>
96783.objectives: Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.
96783.text:
Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.

I have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.

To infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.
96783.title: A Way In

96784.objectives: While disguised as a member of the Syndicate, find someone inside Stromgarde Keep who knows about the secret deal.
96784.text: <You recall Myrokos' instructions to find out about an important deal going on with the Syndicate in Stromgarde Keep. With your disguise, you should be able to talk to members of the Syndicate somewhat freely. Surely, one of them knows something.>
96784.title: Master of Disguise

96785.objectives: Find something within Stromgarde Keep to convince Anastasia to give up details of the secret deal.
96785.text:
Who do you think you are? Showing up and sticking your nose in official business.

I'm not telling some rookie anything about the higher-up's dealings without good reason. Unless you've got something important, or valuable, for me, I've got nothing to say to you.
96785.title: Ain't No Telling

96786.objectives: Break up the secret deal, and take the object being traded to the Syndicate. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.
96786.text:
Falconcrest sent some guys to do a handoff at the southern part of Thoradin's wall. I don't know what they're picking up. Must be good, because everyone involved has kept it a total secret. I don't think the guys picking it up even know what it is.

That's all I've got. Don't make me regret telling you that.
96786.title: The Syndicate Sting

96800.objectives: Retrieve the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.
96800.text:
You there, $C. I have a matter I could use assistance with.

I just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it!

Arcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.
96800.title: Past Due

96821.completion: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
96821.objectives: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
96821.text:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821.title: Legging It

96822.completion: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
96822.objectives: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
96822.progress: Have you done what I asked?
96822.text:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822.title: For Honor

96825.completion: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
96825.objectives: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
96825.text:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96873.completion: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.
96873.objectives: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
96873.progress: What do you have for me, $N?
96873.text:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
96873.title: A Pain in the Neck

96874.completion: These spines are tougher than I expected, $N! Crafting with them may not be as easy as I thought... but I'll keep working on it!
96874.objectives: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
96874.text:
Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.
96874.title: This Is Spinal Axe

96875.completion: Your work helps Orgrimmar grow. Know that as you walk the city's paths.
96875.objectives: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
96875.text:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $C. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

96876.completion: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
96876.objectives: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
96876.text: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
96876.title: Ukor's Lost Pack

96877.completion: What a trophy, $C! That must have been some fight!
96877.text: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.
96877.title: Halikor's Hoof

96895.completion: Stay low and try not to be seen, $C. These cultists are not to be trifled with.
96895.objectives: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
96895.text:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895.title: The Argent Emissary

96896.completion: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.
96896.objectives: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
96896.text:
Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...
96896.title: A Righteous Cause

96897.completion: Thank you for your aid, $C. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
96897.objectives: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
96897.text: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898.completion: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.
96898.objectives: Gather 12 Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
96898.progress: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898.text:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.
96898.title: Remnants of War

96899.completion: This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was here from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.$B$BWhen we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.$B$BShe even named the keep after... a mutual friend.
96899.objectives: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
96899.text:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
96899.title: Bandarion Keep

96984.objectives: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
96984.text:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984.title: Heart of Disruption

96986.objectives: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
96986.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986.title: The Grave Knight

96987.objectives: Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
96987.text:
Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $R!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
96987.title: Opportunistic Education

96988.objectives: Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
96988.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988.title: Source of Power

97003.completion: Impressive, $C. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.$B$BLok-tar!
97003.objectives: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.
97003.progress: It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.$B$BIf these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the qullboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003.text:
You there, $C. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $C.
97003.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97005.completion: My dead men will rest easier knowing that there is one less of these monsters in the world. You've done well, and are a true and stalwart defender of the alliance. Thank you.$B$BGo with honor, $N.
97005.objectives: Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.
97005.progress: It took six of us to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to kill all but myself and one other before we were able to bring it down.$B$BThis far from alliance lands I should leave it well enough alone. Light knows I'll lose little sleep over a few tauren savages or orcish brutes. However, the honor of my fallen brothers demands action.
97005.text:
There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.
97005.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97047.objectives: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.
97047.text:
Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!

I don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!
97047.title: The Cook in the Cage

97048.objectives: Speak to Captain Aransas in Booty Bay.
97048.text: Listen, I can't repay you right now, but I'm a cook on Captain Aransas' ship. I'll be sure to put in a good word for you when I get back to Booty Bay. You should speak to the captain when you get the chance. I'm sure she'll be grateful to have me back.
97048.title: Returning to Port

97066.title: Tip the Scales - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer

97220.completion: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
97220.objectives: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.
97220.progress: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220.text:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220.title: Philmor's Favor

97222.completion: Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.$B$BConsider us professionally acquainted, $C.$B$BWe respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.
97222.objectives: Carry the Gatehouse Shipment up the stairs in Trias' shop and leave it outside the door.
97222.text:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
97222.title: Gatehouse Goods

97223.completion: Thank you, $N. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
97223.objectives: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
97223.progress: The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.$B$BUnfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.$B$BStill I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
97223.text:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225.completion: You have done a great deed for our tribe today.$B$BUnlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.$B$BI would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.
97225.objectives: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
97225.progress: Have you found our loa idols, $N? We must begin our rituals again soon.
97225.text:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97234.completion: Let's see here. Roy's Book Club, isn't it? I recognize this wrap technique.$B$BWell, if he says this is what people want to talk about, it's all fine by me. The material we receive back is always in as good of quality as we loaned it, so we know they're treating it with respect regardless of how provoking the words may be.
97234.objectives: Bring the wrapped reading material to the Stormwind library.
97234.text:
Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.
97234.title: Reading Room

97236.completion: My, my. How I do love surprises, $N.$B$BThis specimen will surely help further my studies.
97236.objectives: Deliver the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
97236.text: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
97236.title: Fang of Githyiss

97237.completion: These are them! Some of them even smell exotic! Fantastic, I can't wait for us to have lively conversations about these writings.$B$BCellar after hours, of course.$B$BThanks for the quick errand run, $N. As promised, it's on the house. We keep our word here.
97237.objectives: Find each of the reading materials located somewhere in the library and then return to Roy Lewells in Stormwind's Park.
97237.progress: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
97237.text:
I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, $N.
97237.title: Shelf Picked

97242.completion: This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.$B$BI'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
97242.objectives: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.
97242.progress: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.
97242.text:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242.title: Yelmak's Medley

97243.completion: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young $C, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.
97243.objectives: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
97243.progress: Yes, $N? What do you have there?
97243.text:
Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243.title: Call of Fire

97244.completion: The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.$B$BThis heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to done.
97244.objectives: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
97244.progress: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.
97244.text:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
97244.title: Call of Fire

97245.completion: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.
97245.objectives: Find the home of Kuramaa in the Shen'dar Highlands, and defeat the spirit in combat. Bring Kuramaa's Mask to Olariaan Swiftburn in the Gustberry Lowlands when you are victorious.
97245.progress: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. It's mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.
97245.text:
The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.

Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.

Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.
97245.title: Call of Fire

97246.completion: Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.$B$BSometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.
97246.objectives: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
97246.text:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246.title: Meal Appeal

97249.completion: Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?$B$BOh!$B$BWow... this smells really good! Yummy.$B$BThanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs.$B$BIf it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
97249.objectives: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.
97249.progress: I think we can win this one...
97249.text:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249.title: Favorite Food

97250.completion: So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.$B$BHowever, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.$B$BIn any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!
97250.objectives: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
97250.text:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!
97250.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

97253.completion: Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.$B$BUhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?
97253.objectives: Collect 5 Handfuls of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet, then return to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet.
97253.progress: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253.text:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253.title: Parts and Pieces

97257.completion: It is done. The Eternal Flame burns once again.$B$BYour trial is now complete. I am pleased to present you with your Fire Totem. Use this icon of power well in your travels, $N.$B$BJust remember, the power of the elemental plane serves those that respect it, and consumes those who do not. This is our way.
97257.objectives:
Wait for Olariaan to begin the ritual at the Brazier of Offering and follow his instructions.

You must deliver the Eternal Flame to Valanaar before the timer runs out.
97257.progress: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, $N.
97257.text:
Now we will perform the ritual. 

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.

Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.
97257.title: Call of Fire

97263.completion: What! I've been going to the mailbox by the bank every day looking for this package! This city needs to figure out its layout. Not easy to navigate like Aerie Peak!$B$BLet's see what I've got... totem carving tools... spare axe... some kind of goblin device? I didn't order that! Ah, I'll just send it back.$B$BEr, uh... I mean... thank you for bringing all of this to me. Here's a little something for your trouble.
97263.text: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
97263.title: Your Package Has Arrived

97265.objectives: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.
97265.text:
Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?

I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?

Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.

Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.
97265.title: Hate the Hatefury

97275.completion: Grorru--whaa?$B$BYou say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.$B$BMaybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.$B$B$N, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.
97275.progress: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
97275.text:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275.title: Whuut's the Rush

97277.completion: Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!$B$BGoz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.$B$BThanks, $N. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.
97277.objectives: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.
97277.progress: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277.text:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277.title: Grund and Gozwin

97279.completion: Thank you for returning these weapons, $N. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.
97279.objectives: Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
97279.progress: Throm'ka, $C. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!$B$BWere you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
97279.text:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.title: Wayward Weapons

97281.completion: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...
97281.objectives: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97281.text:
<Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281.title: A Simmering Storm

97282.completion: Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it.$B$BHere's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works.$B$BEither way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.
97282.objectives: Bring 5 Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97282.progress: It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.$B$BWell, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.$B$BTrust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
97282.text:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity comes knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!
97282.title: Stormy Potential

97284.objectives: Slay Burning Blade orcs at Thunder Axe Fortress in the Desolace, then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point.
97284.text:
If Malem is still alive, then I suspect the Burning Blade orcs are expecting someone to come searching for her soon enough. They will certainly be ready for a fight.

I would prefer if you kept a low profile and stayed out of their way, but the far more likely reality is that they will be looking to meet you, blade to Burning Blade, at every opportunity.

So how about we plan to keep score from the start. Kill as many as you can, and I'll make it worth your time.
97284.title: Vahlarriel's Vengeance

97287.objectives: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
97287.text:
You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
97287.title: Shrewd Negotiations

97288.completion: Oho! I believe I know this head. A cruel joke by our Dark Lady. A delicious one at that.$B$BI think I have a use for this.
97288.objectives: Deliver the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell within the Undercity.
97288.text:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288.title: Unending Torment

97289.completion: <The body twitches to life, panicking as it relives its final moments.>$B$BYou...
97289.objectives: Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the Undercity.
97289.progress: <The abomination remains lifeless without a head to control it.>
97289.text:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289.title: Unending Torment

97290.completion: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.
97290.objectives: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97290.text:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290.title: Unending Torment

97291.completion: These will do nicely. We will see how much bravado our honored guest retains after he is subjected to my masterpiece.
97291.objectives: Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the Herbalism Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97291.progress: It will be ever so lovely to have our lost sheep returned to the fold, don't you think?
97291.text:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291.title: Unending Torment

97292.completion: Excellent. We'll let his flesh simmer for awhile. Give him time to acclimate to his new home.$B$BI have no further use for the wretch for now, but we shall keep an eye on him. I have many plans for Othmar's future.
97292.objectives: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
97292.progress: For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves.$B$BAnd it's funny...
97292.text:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292.title: Unending Torment

97326.completion: How can you even hold all of those boulders!$B$BThose are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.$B$BThanks, $N!
97326.objectives: Return 8 Smooth Boulders to Thra behind Grommash Hold.
97326.progress: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326.title: Rocks to Rests

97328.objectives: Recover 8 Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.
97328.text:
<As you sift through the debris left behind by a horrible zeppelin crash directly above, you find evidence of a hefty shipment of supplies that has long since been plundered of all its value. Even the shipping labels have been torn and shredded, leaving only the words 'Booty Bay' barely legible on one.

Countless two-toed footprints and several patches of divotted earth all lead toward ruins in the northwest.>
97328.title: Anything of Value

97329.objectives: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.
97329.text:
You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!

I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!

I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!

Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.
97329.title: Where's the Key?

97331.objectives: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.
97331.text:
Wait, wait, don't go yet!

I know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here!

You've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh?
97331.title: Zimmix's Great Escape

97420.objectives: Acquire 5 Drums of Crude Oil from the Venture Co. operations at Lake Nazferiti, then return to Knaz Blunderflame in Stranglethorn Vale.
97420.text:
I have a favor to ask of someone, and you look helpful!

You see this baby here? Ain't she a beaut? This is my newest racer, designed and built all by myself, because SOMEONE wouldn't help. I plan on taking this to the races in Thousand Needles, but it needs a little extra kick.

Now, I'm too handsome to be a goblin, and I know better than to trust their tech, but I know the Venture Co struck liquid gold over at the lake. I'm sure they won't mind if you, erm, borrowed some? They won't even notice!
97420.title: Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile

97485.completion: You have done well, friend.$B$BI thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, $N. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.$B$BShould you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.$B$BGo with An'she's warmth.
97485.objectives:
Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.

Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.
97485.progress: There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.$B$BOr it could be something else entirely.$B$BThough the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.
97485.text:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97538.completion: Ah, thank you, $N.$B$BIt means much to me to have you venture all the way out there for what must seem a trivial notion from an old tauren, but with your kindness I will have enough pigment for the rest of the season.$B$BThank you for supporting my livelihood, and I will strive to create something magnificent with the pigments you have brought.
97538.objectives: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants 30 Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.
97538.progress: You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?$B$BWe tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538.text:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
97538.title: Pigments for Paints

97539.objectives: Return 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.
97539.text:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539.title: Silky Sutures

97558.completion: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.
97558.objectives: Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
97558.progress: Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.$B$BIt may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.$B$BSimilarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558.text:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $N. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97583.completion: <The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.>
97583.objectives: Purchase Nutritious Slime Sludge and return to your befriended excitable slime. If it seems tired, try dancing with it again to catch its attention.
97583.progress: <The slime seems to regard you with interest.>
97583.text:
<The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though.

The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated.

It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?>
97583.title: WRIGGLE.

97891.completion: Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!$B$BHere, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?$B$BIf not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.
97891.objectives: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
97891.text:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
97891.title: Prompt Potion Runner

97894.completion: Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.$B$BWe could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
97894.objectives:
Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore.

Borgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there.
97894.text:
Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!

A few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.

I haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?

There's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!
97894.title: Business in Auberdine

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

97914.completion: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>
97914.objectives:
Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

Thundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.
97914.progress: I can smell the sea on you, friend!$B$B<Baros laughs.>$B$BWhat brings you to Stormwind?
97914.text:
Auberdine is a humble place, $C. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914.title: Expanding Horizons

97960.objectives: Speak with Rand Rhobart on the road to Undercity from Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97960.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97960.title: Camping 101: Skinning

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97963.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97964.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97965.progress: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.
97965.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $C.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97965.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97967.progress: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.
97967.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97967.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97968.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97968.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97969.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $C. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97969.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

97977.completion: Oh, it's even worse than I thought.$B$BThese engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...$B$BOur only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, $N.
97977.objectives: Collect 4 Gnarlpine Totems and bring them to Tarindrella.
97977.progress: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977.text:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977.title: Nature's Call

97979.completion: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.
97979.progress: There are few joys so great as basking in Mother Moon's light.
97979.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979.title: The Goddess Provides

97985.completion: Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!$B$BThis heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.$B$BAh, I love it when a plan comes together.
97985.objectives: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.
97985.progress: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.
97985.text:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985.title: Thundering Hearts

98.completion: I know, $N: Stalvan is dead. I sensed a wave of hope ripple through the tainted forest. Once and for all, Duskwood is free from his blood thirst. My joy is hampered by thoughts of those who fell prey to the horrible beast. Nonetheless, you are a brave and cunning $C.
98.objectives: Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
98.text: Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity. Innocent victims died by his hand. Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes. Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire. The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting. Travel to his cottage just north of town, $C, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.$B$BWhen the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring. After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery. But Darkshire is safer because of her.
98.title: The Legend of Stalvan

98013.completion: Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...$B$BIt is unforgivable.
98013.objectives: Eliminate 12 Stormscale Myrmidons, 8 Stormscale Sorceresses, and 6 Stormscale Warriors for Arbal at the Grove of the Ancients.
98013.text:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, $C. War... is what we will bring.
98013.title: Swelling Forces

98021.completion: I've been begging Stormwind for aid for months and he sends me a skinny elf? Well, beggars can't be choosers I suppose.$B$BWelcome to Westfall, $C. Let's see if we can't put you to work.
98021.objectives: Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
98021.text:
If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

Good luck out there, adventurer!
98021.title: Journey to Sentinel Hill

98024.completion: What's this? An elf? And you say the Warchief sent you?$B$B<Thork grunts sharply as he looks you up and down.>$B$BYou look a little skinny to me, but it matters not. Out here you'll either thrive and survive, or you'll die. That is the way of things in these lands.
98024.objectives: Report To Thork at The Crossroads in The Barrens.
98024.text:
After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.

Go with honor, adventurer!
98024.title: Journey to the Crossroads

98025.completion: It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness.$B$BRegardless, thank you for your service today, $C. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
98025.objectives: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
98025.progress: Greetings $C - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98027.completion: Oh my! I can't believe you found this. I thought I had looked everywhere!$B$BI had lost it when I went to deliver supplies to one of our outposts, but after searching along the road I had given up.$B$BThank you for bringing this back to me. It was a gift from my late parents, and I can't express how much it means to have it back.
98027.objectives: Deliver the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.
98027.text:
<The silver necklace in your hands gleams gently as you examine it. The small crescent moon shape seems similar to other night elf symbols you've seen before.

Upon flipping the necklace over there is a small inscription: "Alor'lormah, Maliynn". Perhaps it belongs to Maliynn in Astranaar?>
98027.title: Gleaming Crescent Necklace

98028.completion: <Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>$B$BStairs descending down in Mathystra? Could be it be?$B$B<Onu shakes his head.>$B$BI must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.$B$BPlease accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.
98028.objectives: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
98028.progress: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, $R... what have you brought me?
98028.text:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028.title: Baron Marinous

98042.completion: <Thundris does not speak for some time.>$B$BThis bears the mark of an ancient evil, $C. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.$B$BAnde'thoras-ethil.
98042.objectives: Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.
98042.progress: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98046.completion: Do not mind the Arch Druid, $N. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence.$B$BWait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?
98046.objectives: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98046.text:
<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, $C. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046.title: Crown of the Earth

98059.completion: Good work, soldier. I know you're not stationed with us, but we never turn away capable hands.$B$BIf they don't respond to THIS letter, we'll have to be more crude in our messaging.$B$BWe'll keep you on reserve for civilian interactions should the need arise again.
98059.objectives: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.
98059.text:
Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.

We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.

Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.

Return to me when the deed is done.
98059.title: Hillsbrad's Hoard

98065.completion: Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.$B$B<Tyrande's face settles.>$B$BI apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.$B$BFandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.$B$BEvery drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.
98065.objectives: Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98065.progress: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
98065.text:
You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
98065.title: Crown of the Earth

98067.completion: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.
98067.objectives: Place Sentinel Owls at the entrance to the Cenarion Hold depths, the Darnassus Bank, the Craftsman's Terrace Inn, and the City Gate for Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98067.progress: We must remain vigilant, for though Darnassus is well-protected our enemies are everywhere.
98067.text:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98069.completion: Thank you, $N. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.
98069.objectives: Bring 8 Stolen Freewind Supplies to Jandia in Freewind Post.
98069.progress: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069.text:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
98069.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98070.completion: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.
98070.objectives: Slay 5 Screeching Harpies, 5 Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and 5 Screeching Windcaller Harpies.
98070.text:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
98070.title: Stop the Screeching

98071.completion: That's the hops smell I missed! Ye done me a great favor, $N, takes me days to leave every time I make the trip to Dun Garok myself. Hard to pull me self outta the halls o' that fortress once I get comfortable.$B$BHappy to keep some old tastes on the shelf for fellow dwarves.$B$BHave a little somethin' for helpin out.
98071.objectives: Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.
98071.progress: Lookin' ta try a new ale?
98071.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071.title: Brewer's Trade

98072.completion: You're a real natural talent! Say, if you ever decide to take a break from the adventuring life, you come on back to your buddy James. I'll put you right to work!$B$BAlthough, I suppose you'll be even older by then. Oh well!
98072.objectives: Collect 8 Pristine Crimson Scales and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
98072.progress: Ah, $N! Do you have those scales?
98072.text:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
98072.title: Crocs of the Sky

98093.completion: Thank you for helping me out, $N. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!$B$BThis is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.$B$BI'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.
98093.objectives: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out 7 Stormhide lizards and 7 Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.
98093.progress: There might be a chance to get down without them noticing me soon...
