98093.text:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
98093.title: Field to Clear

98094.completion: Quaint. A fresh face for the field work.$B$BWell, let's see what you have then.
98094.objectives: High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok.
98094.text:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094.title: Scout Support

98095.completion: Good work. We advance the plans.$B$BDeathstalkers dare.$B$BLet purpose guide your strikes, $N.
98095.objectives: Deathstalker Masoj needs you to place the three Apothecary Vials on peaks around Hillsbrad Foothills and return to him.
98095.text:
Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
98095.title: Valuable Vantages

98155.completion: Thank you, $N! These hides are in perfect condition. I can't imagine it was easy to get so many, but I am very grateful to you for your work.
98155.objectives: Bring 5 Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.
98155.progress: Were you able to collect the pelts? Rendow has promised to help me clean and tan them to send back home! I know my sisters will be very excited.
98155.text:
The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!

I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.

I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
98155.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

98156.completion: This is from our sister? We hadn't heard from her in some time. I hope she is doing well.$B$BMy, these pelts have such a beautiful color of fur! Kelly and I will make sure we put these to good use.$B$BThank you for making the long journey. It is good to know Kristy is still doing well and is thinking of us.
98156.objectives: Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.
98156.text:
$N, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead?

I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
98156.title: Packaged Pristine Pelts

98189.completion: You managed to get it back from those monsters! There aren't too many artifacts of the late king left now.
98189.objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
98189.progress: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189.text:
My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
98189.title: Return the Statuette

98190.completion: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.
98190.objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
98190.progress: Let us speak, $C. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190.text:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, $glad:lass;. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190.title: A Friend of the Family

98191.completion: By the Light... it looks just like his boy...$B$B<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>$B$BThis statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.$B$BIt is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.$B$BThank you, $C. Light bless you.
98191.objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.
98191.progress: Light be with you, $C. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191.text:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191.title: A Friend of the Family

98197.completion: Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix.$B$BThank you, $C. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!
98197.objectives: Recover 6 Khaz Modan Timber and 30 Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.
98197.progress: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197.title: Spoils of War

982.completion: You've done us here in Auberdine a great service, lad. We'll make sure that their effects are properly taken care of.$B$BAs for you, please have this. It is the least I can do for someone with the bravery to set things right.
982.objectives: Recover the Silver Dawning's Lockbox and the Mist Veil's Lockbox for Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine. Both items should be found aboard the wreckage of the ships to the north of the village.
982.progress: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982.text: Off the coast of Darkshore to our north are two wrecked ships - the Silver Dawning and the Mist Veil. Some time ago, both ships ran afoul of the blasted murlocs as they sailed across the vast sea into Auberdine. They now lie at the bottom of the ocean as trophies for those fiends.$B$BBoth captains didn't make it out that night, and their logs and other effects are still below in lockboxes. I'd like for you to recover them for us; it would mean a lot to the crew members still around these parts.
982.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

98208.completion: It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!$B$BA thousand thanks, $N. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...
98208.objectives: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.
98208.progress: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208.text:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
98208.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209.completion: The Nord'el survived? It cannot be... after all these years!$B$BOur goddess is most wonderful indeed!$B$BYou have my thanks for delivering it here. It is a rare light in the dark times we have had of late, and a symbol of not only Elune's grace, but of the enduring will of our people to persevere without our immortality.$B$BI will see to it that it is transported safely to Darnassus, so that it may be properly cultivated.
98209.objectives:
Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.

You recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.
98209.progress: I welcome you to Auberdine, $C. How may we be of aid to you in your travels?
98209.text:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
98209.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98216.completion: Look there--see how the Goaz Stone starts to glow when near the keystone? I can almost make out some more words...$B$BWe still must learn more about this Goaz. I feel like we're just on the tip of the iceberg with something huge!
98216.objectives: Use the Goaz Stone near the Goaz Warder and bring its Titanic Keystone back to Prospector Whelgar.
98216.text:
Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!

I've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!

Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!

If I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!
98216.title: Understanding Our Present

98219.completion: Ah, of course. Another one of Stormwind's finest here to check on me. Same as last month!
98219.objectives: Speak to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
98219.text:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, $N.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219.title: The Shamed Lieutenant

98221.completion: Ironforge as well? Nek'rosh certainly has his father's ambition!$B$BWhat he lacks, of course, is the enslaved army of red drakes that proved so devastating in the war. He's made a gambit, alright--one he will pay for dearly.
98221.objectives: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.
98221.progress: Wars are won--and lost--on information. You would do well to remember that.
98221.text:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221.title: From the Ashes

98223.completion: It's best we destroy this. Useful or not, we're not in the business of taking chances with any of those foul orcs.$B$BThe last thing we need are dragonriders on our doorstep!$B$BAnd this Shadow Council business... most troubling. I'll send word to my superiors at once.
98223.objectives: Bring the Tattered Spellbook to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor.
98223.progress: I can practically hear the cries of the Dragonmaw from here! They deserve every bit of it and more.
98223.text:
This book has been badly burned--perhaps by the dragonfire that destroyed much of the Dragonmaw clan.

Of what little is legible, it seems to describe rituals relating to the use of the Demon Soul that the clan had used to control the dragons.

It is far too incomplete to be of real use, but based on roughly inserted pages on animal hide it seems Nek'rosh had attempted to salvage it. Freshly dried ink mentions a "Shadow Council."

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor would want to know about this.
98223.title: Old Habits

98230.completion: If yer here to help, I won't say no. Help's awful hard to come by these days.
98230.objectives: Find Howin Kindfeather east of Menethil Harbor, along the road.
98230.text:
After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.

It was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.

It didn't last long, sadly.

Howin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.
98230.title: This Land Was Their Land

98240.completion: These are perfect. Thank ye for making the journey.
98240.objectives: Bring the Crimson Crate to Howin Kindfeather off the road to the east of Menethil Harbor.
98240.text:
Word is officially out on those whelps, $N. We already have an order in!

I'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!

These will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.
98240.title: Crimson Crate Delivery

98245.completion: These'll make a beautiful set of awls. Thank ye.
98245.objectives: Collect 10 Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather.
98245.progress: Any luck prying those teeth off? I need 'em whole so they don't snap on the scales right away.
98245.text:
I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.
98245.title: Razormaw Needling

98246.completion: They're not for me plan--they're to feed Bassbeak. She's of no help at all if she's hungry, trust me. She might be more dangerous than the orcs if she's ticked off!$B$BUntainted food can be hard to come by in these lands as of late...
98246.objectives: Gather 12 Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.
98246.progress: The Razormaw won't be none too happy about you taking their eggs, so be ready for a squabble.
98246.text:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
98246.title: Trying Times

98247.completion: You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.$B$BWhen you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.$B$BNow, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247.objectives: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub in Redridge Mountains.
98247.progress: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247.title: Shipping Label

98248.completion: You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.$B$BAll we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find out during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!$B$BDo you happen to have the crate this label came with?
98248.objectives: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub near the Crossroads in the Barrens.
98248.progress: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?
98248.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98248.title: Shipping Label

98251.completion: Ha! That's right, you beasts!$B$BThanks. That does seem to already have helped.
98251.objectives: Kill 6 Shadowhorn Stag and 6 Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.
98251.progress: Once I get out of this place, I'm never returning.
98251.text:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.
98251.title: Never Coming Back

98252.completion: <You hear the voice of Va'xug echoing from within the floating eye.>$B$B"Was it that simple? No matter. This vision will assist me in wrangling my unruly Voidwalker along the correct trail when I resummon him. Thank you, traveler. Cut through this forest with sure steps."$B$B<The Eye of Kilrogg begins to dissipate.>
98252.objectives: Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.
98252.text:
Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.

I'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.

I can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.
98252.title: A Void Path

98282.completion: Oh, perfect! This is exactly what I need. You're a real hero, you know.$B$BPlease, I'd be remiss if I didn't share some of the fruits of your labors with you. Stay safe out there!
98282.objectives: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
98282.progress: Have you had any luck? I know it's a pain to ask, but I really do need a whole gland!
98282.text:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282.title: Alchemical Hazards

98283.completion: Carnage's death will bring balance to his pack. Perhaps it will buy enough time for the greater ecosystem they support.$B$BWe shall see, but I thank you for the effort regardless.
98283.objectives: Bring Carnage's Head to Rethiel the Greenwarden in The Green Belt.
98283.progress: The Rotclaw came down from their homes in Loch Modan, now driven mad.$B$BSuch a waste of life's boon.
98283.text:
The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.

I fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.

It will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.

Carnage will come. Bring me its head.
98283.title: Carnage

98284.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
98284.objectives: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98284.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98284.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

98285.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
98285.objectives: Speak with the Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98285.text:
An engineer is ever-resourceful, and if you are in the wilds alone, it's always good to be able to put your trade to use. No good camp is complete without a few helpful constructs!

Yes, come back and see me when you've gained a little bit of experience as an engineer and I can show you how to make something special!
98285.title: Camping 101: Engineering

98286.completion: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
98286.objectives: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98286.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98286.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

98287.objectives: Speak with Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98287.text:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
98287.title: Camping 101: Engineering

98291.completion: You won't catch me mournin' their ilk. They deserve their fate.
98291.objectives: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Reclaimers, 5 Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and 3 Dragonmaw Infiltrators in Dragonmaw Retreat for Howin Kindfeather.
98291.text:
I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, $N. Or at least learn a thing or two.

Don't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.

Regardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.

I need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.
98291.title: Death to the Dragonmaw

98293.completion: Well done! Very well done!$B$BWe can definitely put these to use in replenishing our men. Half of these are from our own soldiers to begin with.$B$BFewer weapons in the hands of the enemy and more in ours is my kind of math, $C.
98293.objectives: Collect 30 Dragonmaw Armaments in Dragonmaw Retreat, then bring them to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
98293.text:
The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.
98293.title: Forced Disarmament

98297.completion: I can't thank ye enough, $N. Truly, I cannae do enough for what ye've done today.$B$BMuch remains to be done before Grim Batol might hear the laughter of wee dwarven children echo through its halls again, but it's a mighty good step closer.$B$BFor all of the dwarves lost in those dark days, we may yet reclaim what was ours.$B$BHere's hopin', anyway.
98297.objectives: Kill the Subdued Dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates for Howin Kindfeather.
98297.text:
I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!

The very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.

Absolutely not. Not again.

You have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.

None of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.
98297.title: Stopping the Cycle

98298.completion: It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.$B$BThese pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.$B$BRegrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.
98298.objectives: Bring 6 Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
98298.progress: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
98298.text:
Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
98298.title: Arugal's Folly

98299.completion: It seems the Gilneans are not too keen on allowing anyone past their wall. That is fortunate, I suppose. It means there is likely no chance for the worgen curse to spread to their city.$B$BCan you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?
98299.objectives: Slay 5 Sickly Refugees and 5 Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
98299.text:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, $R.
98299.title: Stop the Spread

98300.completion: Ah, the Wildhammer. Yes, I know them well. They may not call me sovereign, but our relations have improved greatly as of late--the Thandol Span is a testament to that.$B$BIf what this Howin reports is true, then we must prepare for further action on our northern borders. Grim Batol has a deep, bloody history, and I'm well aware of its strategic significance.$B$BFor your efforts in helping the Wildhammer in the Wetlands, and the Alliance in Menethil Harbor as well, you have my thanks.
98300.objectives: Deliver Howin's Missive to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
98300.progress: Welcome to Ironforge, $C. I am King Magni Bronzebeard, ruler of these lands.
98300.text:
My work here is far from over, $N. And I need tae send word to me wife Claira in Aerie Peak--and get Falstad an update as well.

But that's my business. Wildhammer business.

That said, you ought tae let King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge know about all this as well. Wetlands is but a stone's throw from his lands, and none of what's happenin' here is good news on one's doorstep. This letter oughta do the trick.

Ye can travel back through Dun Algaz or fly from Menethil Harbor to get to Ironforge.
98300.title: Word to Ironforge

98310.completion: By Magni's beard, they're beautiful! Wait a second, do you see that?! Hold the hearts closer to the Goaz Stone for a moment...$B$B<New text reveals itself on the stone in a faint shimmering light.>$B$BHmm, it's hard to make out. "Curse of Flesh... they will fail." What's that supposed to mean?!$B$BWe've got to get this somewhere safe so we can study it further!
98310.objectives: Use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru and bring their hearts back to Prospector Whelgar.
98310.progress: Be careful out there. I suspect these constructs will be tougher than the warder was.
98310.text:
There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!

I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!

You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.
98310.title: Gleaning Our Future

98313.completion: Well I'll be...$B$BThis is a lot to go through! Very exciting, though. VERY exciting!$B$BIt'll take me some time to even put a plan together on this one. Come back another time and I can give you the latest. For now, please accept the thanks of the Explorers' League.
98313.objectives: Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
98313.progress: Apologies, I'm terribly, terribly busy. Did you need something?
98313.text:
Whatever this is all about, $N, it's epic stuff alright.

I'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.

It'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
98313.title: For Further Study

98319.completion: Ach, the fool...$B$BThank ye for the help, $N. Guess we have our report.
98319.objectives: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.
98319.progress: Any news? I told Cornelius not tae go into the Grizzled Den alone, but he's always been a stubborn sort.
98319.text:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
98319.title: Secure the Mountain

98321.completion: Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!
98321.objectives: Collect 8 Flintfire Shipments from the Grizzled Den for Tongus Flintfire in Kharanos.
98321.progress: Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321.text:
Hoha! Good to see a $R who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98322.completion: Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?$B$BI got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!
98322.objectives: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.
98322.text:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322.title: Secure the Mountain

98323.completion: Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised.$B$BWell, that's going in the report too.$B$B<Senir folds Gretchen's letter into his pile of notes>
98323.objectives: Deliver Mountaineer Gretchen's Report back to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
98323.progress: Ah, you're back just in time.$B$BWhat's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323.text:
Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, $N. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.
98323.title: Secure the Mountain

98326.completion: Yer a real lifesaver, $N!$B$BMy husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
98326.objectives: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village.
98326.progress: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
98326.text:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
98326.title: Frosthowl

98340.completion: And so it continues, Father Cenarius.$B$B<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.>$B$BGreetings again, $N. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.
98340.objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
98340.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98340.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98341.completion: Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not.$B$BI will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of a Azerothian cat spirit.$B$BLet us begin.
98341.objectives: Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in the southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.
98341.text:
A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.

It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
98341.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98342.completion: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.$B$BI now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $C.
98342.objectives: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.
98342.progress: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98342.text:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98342.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98362.completion: Welcome back, $N. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.$B$BI will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.
98362.objectives: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
98362.text:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98362.title: To Thunder Bluff

98386.completion: The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.$B$BI'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, $N!
98386.objectives: Slay 12 Greater Tarantulas and destroy 6 Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.
98386.text:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
98386.title: Alther's Mill

98387.completion: Excellent work, $N. With the Blackrock orcs cut off from their allies in the Burning Steppes, they will have no hope of maintaining their foothold here without proper supplies.
98387.objectives: Bring 8 Stolen Weapons and 10 Blackrock Supplies to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
98387.progress: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387.title: Blackrock Blockade

98389.completion: May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.$B$BThey will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.$B$BLight be with you.
98389.objectives: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
98389.progress: Have you freed the poor, unfortunate souls trapped in that cave?
98389.text:
Greetings, $C. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
98389.title: A Light in the Darkness

98391.completion: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.
98391.objectives: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
98391.text:
Blessings to you, $C. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98392.completion: <Arynia investigates the amulets.>$B$BDo you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.$B$BI have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.$B$BI will inform my superiors of this at once.
98392.objectives: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
98392.progress: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392.text:
These belts... look closely at the leather, $N. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
98392.title: Darkness in the Glade

98393.completion: And so it continues, Father Cenarius.$B$B<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.>$B$BGreetings again, $N. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.
98393.objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
98393.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98393.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98394.completion: I see you have come to learn to draw upon my spirit. Good. Let us see if you are ready to take my shape.
98394.objectives: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.
98394.text:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98394.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98396.completion: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.$B$BI now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $C.
98396.objectives: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.
98396.progress: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98396.text:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98396.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98397.completion: Welcome back, $N. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.$B$BI will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.
98397.objectives: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
98397.text:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98397.title: To Darnassus

98398.completion: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.
98398.objectives: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.
98398.text: I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, $N. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.$B$BI have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
98398.title: The Oracle Tree

98403.completion: I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.$B$BI have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.$B$BNormally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we kept this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.$B$BI trust you to do the same.
98403.objectives: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
98403.progress: <Tallonkai lowers his voice.>$B$BDoes Xethorr still walk freely?
98403.text:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403.title: Twisted Hatred

98404.completion: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.$B$BI now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $C.
98404.objectives: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Avatar of Saeyleenan.
98404.progress: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98404.text:
In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
98404.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98405.completion: I see you have come to learn to draw upon my spirit. Good. Let us see if you are ready to take my shape.
98405.objectives: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.
98405.text:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98405.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98407.completion: Quite the armful you have.$B$BWhile this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, $N.
98407.objectives: Collect 5 Spiked Collars from Redridge Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.
98407.progress: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407.text:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
98407.title: Show of Force

98417.completion: Oh no... words like these do not bring me comfort. Kurothel must be more than living in the wild, he's living more like a wild beast each passing night.$B$BI fear the whispers must be true.
98417.objectives: Maseara Autumnmoon wants you to search west of Forest Song, amongst the Satyrnaar demons. Report any signs of her husband Kurothel upon your return.
98417.progress: What have you found within the hills of our forest?
98417.text:
At the moment our fates bound us most vulnerable, tragedy fell upon our villages. Satyrs defiled our temples, their profane touch staining sacred boughs, and they slaughtered the innocent without mercy.

Kurothel was consumed by wrath. The druids are taking the fight to the satyr, and he has followed.

Our bond endures. I feel my husband, west, within these woods. Please, return to me with news of his fate.
98417.title: Vengeful Trail

98418.completion: There was a welling up of... Elune's light within and around me. I feel Kurothel has witnessed your act of battle within this war that rages within our land, and within our hearts.$B$BMy hopes are that with time, the efforts of our Sentinels and our wayward druids will eliminate the demonic menace once and for all. Perhaps then and only then will the feral drive for vengeance burn out from our lineage's heritage.$B$BThank you, $N. You are an ally to the forest, and a friend of the Kaldorei.
98418.objectives:
Kill 5 Xavian Rogues, 5 Felsworn, 5 Betrayers, and 5 Hellcallers.
Return to Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song afterwards.
98418.text:
Kurothel mentioned sightings of what they say are wolf-men. Those of the pack now lurking in greater numbers in our forest. Last we had spoken, druids were pursuing communication with those of the beast heart who displayed measured control of their animal instincts.

His written words show a darker struggle. If there is anything we can do to help see HIM again, surely quelling the demon threat that is driving him to this burning transformation will be of aid to his anguished soul.

Slay the Xavian, $N.
98418.title: Shared Fury

98423.completion: Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.$B$BAs you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.$B$BThank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, $C.
98423.objectives: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
98423.progress: What have you brought from the depths, $C.
98423.text: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98424.completion: Ah, this is most valuable knowledge. I thank you for your efforts.$B$B<Morin looks through the notes.>$B$BIt seems our next move is clear.
98424.objectives: Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
98424.progress: What is it you bring me, $C?
98424.text:
Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
98424.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

98427.completion: All of Bloodhoof Village is in your debt this day. May the Earth Mother's grace stay with you always.
98427.objectives: Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.
98427.text:
The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.

Entire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millennia--erased in days.

We will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.

$N, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.
98427.title: Ceasing Operations

98430.completion: I am relieved that Longwalker Stormhoof is well. He is my most trusted scout, and his mission of the utmost importance.$B$BPlease, accept my thanks and my hospitality for riskng your life to save his own. You have done a greater service to our people than you know.$B$BI encourage you to explore our great city while you are here. It is a place of safety, and you will find many that may aid you on your own travels upon its bluffs.$B$BIsh-ne-alo por-ah.
98430.objectives: Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
98430.text:
Hail, $C. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
98430.title: The Longwalkers

98435.completion: Ah, no wonder there is such joy running through the streams of Mulgore. You have done a great service today. The wells provide much for not only our people, but to the wildlife we depend on for food, clothing, and companionship.$B$BIt is my humble pleasure to honor Mull's request. Please, accept this token of my gratitude.
98435.objectives: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
98435.text:
Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.

Please, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
98435.title: Thunderhorn's Report

98447.objectives: Find the cause of the Valor family ghosts in Raven Hill for Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
98447.text:
Despite you putting down the Valor family ghosts, the reports of attacks have not ceased. It was a good gamble, but perhaps we did not settle their unfinished business after all.

From my research, it sounds like this family all went missing at the same time. Whatever trauma caused their spirits to be chained to this realm must have happened all at once.

Our only clue is where you found the book. Return to Raven Hill and see what you can find. Maybe bringing their weapons will spark something.
98447.title: The Valor Family

98459.completion: <Bart unwraps the gift.>$B$BWhy that no good, son of a--$B$BDid he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!$B$BI swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--$B$BI'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
98459.objectives: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
98459.progress: Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!$B$BOh? What's that you have there, traveler?
98459.text:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
98459.title: A Lack of Virtue

98461.completion: <Tarrel reads the note.>$B$BOh... oh my. Poor Hollee.$B$BShe always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!$B$BI think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!
98461.objectives: Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
98461.text:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
98461.title: Unrequited Love

98463.completion: I've got what you need, pal! Stay awhile, spend some of that gold weighing down your pocket, and have a good time.$B$BWelcome to the Salty Sailor Tavern!
98463.objectives: Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.
98463.text:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
98463.title: Talk of the Town

98471.objectives: Meet Elaadrin Evengale at the cliffs overlooking The Uplands in Alterac Mountains.
98471.text:
Greetings, $N. 

I have an assignment for you that is of the utmost priority. Please meet me in the mountains called Alterac, northwest of the village known as Strahnbrad. I will meet you at the cliff overlooking the Uplands valley.

Come alone, and tell no one.
98471.title: Message from the Supreme Magister

98512.completion: I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers.$B$BThank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.
98512.objectives: Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.
98512.progress: I wonder what they are after?
98512.text:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

98517.objectives:
Report to Sessaria Skystride or Aarnor Galestrike on Zephras Isle to continue your training as a Shaman. 

You can return to Zephras via the skycutter transport that docks in Mulgore at Skywatcher Plateau, northwest of Thunder Bluff.
98517.text: Greetings, young Skyborne. The spirits have spoken of you, and tell me that you are ready to heed the call of fire. However, I shall not be the one to start you on that Path. Return to your home in the elemental plane, seek your mentors there. They will tell you what must be done.
98517.title: Call of Fire

98545.completion: Thanks for delivering this, pal.$B$BWait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that!$B$BFine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.
98545.objectives: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.
98545.progress: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545.text:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
98545.title: Leonid's Letter

98574.completion: With time and practice, you'll discover new facets to the Light. In a way, it's finding a union between what you think and what you feel. As you deepen your connection with the Light, you can come back to me to talk about what you've learned. I'll be happy to show you how to tap into that force to teach ya how to heal, or to smite the wicked. For a small donation, of course!
98574.objectives: Read the Hallowed Memorandum and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.
98574.progress: Ah, another $R comin' ta learn about the Light! You'll find that deepening your connection to the Light relies on curiosity and intelligence, qualities that many gnomes have in abundance. The way o' the Light isn't a technical discipline, it's a riddle, and one that provides both life lessons and practical blessings.
98574.text: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98574.title: Hallowed Memorandum

98575.completion: You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates.$B$BGuard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand.$B$BNow you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.
98575.objectives: Read the Tainted Tablet and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
98575.progress: Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the trolls.
98575.text: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.$B$BI usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
98575.title: Tainted Tablet

98576.completion: Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.$B$BWhen ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
98576.objectives: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
98576.progress: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.
98576.text: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
98576.title: Glyphic Parchment

98581.completion: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
98581.objectives: Read the Archaic Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
98581.progress: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a $C.
98581.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the shaman trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581.title: Archaic Rune

98601.completion: Your training can now begin in earnest, $C. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
98601.objectives: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.
98601.text:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601.title: A Difficult Path

98731.text:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.
98731.title: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit

98738.text:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further.

Unfortunately I have little left to teach you for the moment. I do hope you come and visit me in Zephras again someday. I sense promise in you, young shen'dorei.

May the shadows forever hide you, your foes easily fall prey to your claws, and the winds guide your steps.
98738.title: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98739.completion: <Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>$B$BI sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.$B$BNow you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.
98739.text:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.
98739.title: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit

98815.completion: These are some of the most impressive hides I've ever held; these will make spectacular detailing on all of my fine trim. Thank you, $N.$B$BTry these on and take one you'd like in trade.
98815.objectives: Return 4 Thicket Raptor Hides to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.
98815.progress: Welcome back, $C. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
98815.text:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?

I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
98815.title: Highland Hides

98823.completion: Ah... this shard hums with the voice of the world itself. The light within is a memory from the past, glimmering with flashes of history. This titan machine must have been waiting to be understood for lifetimes.$B$BYou've done wisely to bring it to us. The Earthen Ring will safeguard it, study it, and share the truths it keeps when we are able to receive its messages.$B$BYou honor the elements today, traveler.
98823.objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.text:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.

You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.title: Earthen Echo

98824.completion: What's this you've got...$B$BWoah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.$B$BYou've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.$B$BWe'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.
98824.objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.
98824.progress: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.
98824.text:
With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.

I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by $N! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.

High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.

Good find!
98824.title: Prehistoric Prism

98887.completion: The sands of the Darkspear Islands are awash with the blood of the Alliance you've killed. Well done, $N.$B$BFor the Horde!
98887.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
98887.progress: What news from the Darkspear Islands, $N?
98887.text: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.$B$BGo, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98887.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98888.completion: Well done, $C! You've helped the Horde gain control of Darkspear Islands!
98888.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98889.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
98889.text: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.$B$BGo, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98889.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98891.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
98891.text: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.$B$BGo, show them the might of the horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98891.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98893.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
98893.text: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.$B$BGo, show them the might of the horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
