98893.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98895.completion: You've distinguished yourself honorably in battle at the Darkspear Islands and your efforts have not gone unnoticed.$B$BThere are ever more battles to fight, however. Continue to prove yourself in battle and you will surely reap the rewards.
98895.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
98895.progress: How goes your campaign in the Darkspear Islands, $N?
98895.text: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.$B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98895.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98896.completion: Excellent work, $C! With each blow struck against the Darkspear Raiders, we move one step closer to total victory.$B$BFor the Alliance!
98896.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98897.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
98897.text: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.$B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98897.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98899.text: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.$B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98899.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98901.text: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.$B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98901.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98903.completion: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are grateful for your dedication and prowess in the battle for the Darkspear Islands, $N.$B$BFor the Alliance!
98903.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.
98903.text: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $N! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98903.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98904.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.
98904.text: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $N! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98904.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98905.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.
98905.text: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $N! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98905.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98906.completion: You be showin' strength and dedication out at the Darkspear Islands! Your prowess in battle are to be admired, mon!
98906.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
98906.text:
The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $C. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. 

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $C!
98906.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98907.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
98907.text: The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $C. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $C!

The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $C. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. 

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $C!
98908.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

99046.completion: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...
99046.objectives: Search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road leading to the Oracle Glade.
99046.text:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
99046.title: The Lost Runner

99047.completion: The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.$B$BWe must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
99047.objectives: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolanaar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
99047.text:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047.title: Not Dead Yet

99048.completion: Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.$B$BWhatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
99048.objectives: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
99048.text:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048.title: A Missing Hand

99049.completion: This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.$B$BWe cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.
99049.objectives: Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.
99049.text:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049.title: Threat from Below

99050.completion: Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.$B$BNow, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.
99050.objectives: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.
99050.progress: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
99050.text:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050.title: The Great Tree Provides

99051.completion: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.
99051.progress: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?
99051.text:
It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.

Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
99051.title: Threat from Below

99052.completion: Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!$B$BBe proud of your kill today, not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.
99052.objectives: Kill the sea giant along Durotar's north coast and bring back proof of your accomplishment.
99052.text:
One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.

It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
99052.title: Threat from Below

99053.completion: Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend.$B$BPlease, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.
99053.objectives: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.
99053.text:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.

I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
99053.title: Escaping Ban'ethil

99073.completion: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>
99073.objectives: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.
99073.progress: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>
99073.text:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
99073.title: Easing Suffering

99079.completion: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.
99079.objectives: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.
99079.text:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079.title: Longwalker Malah

99080.completion: You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.$B$BI could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!$B$BToday marks a great victory for our village, and a security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young $C.
99080.objectives: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.
99080.text:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080.title: Drive Them Out

99081.completion: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!
99081.objectives: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.
99081.text:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081.title: Grim Tidings

99082.completion: The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?!$B$BYou have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again!$B$BPlease accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.
99082.objectives: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
99082.text:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
99082.title: The High Chieftain

99101.completion: <Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>$B$BThis will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, $N.
99101.objectives: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.
99101.progress: What is it you bring me, $C?
99101.text:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99108.completion: You honor me with your abilities, $C. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.$B$BTake these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108.objectives: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.
99108.progress: There is no teacher quite like the sharp end of your adversary pointed at your heart.
99108.text:
Hail, young $C. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108.title: Sparring Match

99123.completion: Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?$B$BHopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.
99123.objectives: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
99123.text:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
99123.title: Lost in the Shadows

99127.completion: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.
99127.objectives: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.
99127.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127.title: A Net Disaster

99128.completion: I can hear their warbling from here, it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.
99128.objectives: Kill the murlocs at Crystal Lake.
99128.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128.title: Slimy Menace

99129.completion: I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.$B$BI have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.
99129.objectives: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.
99129.text:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
99129.title: A Man About a Murloc

99130.completion: Give me just a minute...$B$BIt's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.
99130.text:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.
99130.title: An Enticing Offer

99131.completion: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.
99131.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.
99131.title: Baited for Success

99134.completion: There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.$B$BYou please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.
99134.text:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--$N, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99134.title: Discipline

99141.completion: I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.$B$BYou have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.
99141.objectives: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
99141.progress: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141.text:
Make no mistake, $C--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141.title: Patience

99142.completion: Most glorious indeed!$B$B<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>$B$BHmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!$B$BA great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.
99142.objectives: Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
99142.progress: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142.text:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142.title: Tomb Weed

99143.completion: An interesting collection. These should work well enough!$B$BHere's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.
99143.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.
99143.progress: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143.title: Bottles and Baubles

99144.completion: Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and it would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time.$B$BPlease accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.
99144.objectives: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
99144.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144.title: Seeking Refuge

99152.completion: Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.$B$BWith these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
99152.objectives: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
99152.progress: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152.text:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
99152.title: As Above, So Below

99153.completion: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...
99153.objectives: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
99153.progress: Did you find the damned thing?
99153.text:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
99153.title: The One That Got Away

99156.completion: You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.$B$BPlease accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.
99156.objectives: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
99156.progress: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156.text:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
99156.title: Rear Guard Patrol

99158.completion: Ah. Candles from Ironforge.$B$BWhile I am mostly able to live independently in my hermitage, there are a few key things that I appreciate from the city and the pious.
99158.objectives: Bring the crate of candles to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge.
99158.progress: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159.completion: Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry.$B$BNow, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.
99159.progress: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159.text:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159.title: Finding Warmth

99160.completion: I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.
99160.text:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.
99160.title: Rime's Wrath

99161.completion: Light bless you, $C. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.
99161.objectives: Kill Avala and retrieve its core.
99161.text:
I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasional weather changes and other minor slides.

I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.
99161.title: Rime's Wrath

99162.completion: The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.
99162.objectives: Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers.
99162.text:
Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
99162.title: Treacherous Cold

99191.completion: Wonderful!$B$BWe thank you for your generous donation, $N!
99191.title: A Donation of Wool

99196.completion: We thank you for your generous donation!$B$BWinds be with you, friend.
99196.title: A Donation of Wool

99260.completion: Thank you for saving Fillion, $N. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is.$B$BWithout that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth is at serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret.$B$BAs ever, their own dogmatic hubris take precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.
99260.objectives: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.
99260.text:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
99260.title: Fillion's Mission

99411.completion: Fantastic work, $N! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
99411.objectives: Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.$B$BFeed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
99411.text: Help, $N! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.$B$BWill you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.$B$BTo feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
99411.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
